chosen.text: This biosensor uses graphene, a new material, and its target is chemical elements. Its sensitive “sense of smell” allows it to reflect the health condition more deeply and accurately.

src: 光电科学与工程学院硕士生朱林靖、申俊飞团队在传统手术灯的缺陷中开启了新思路，发明了智能LED手术无影灯。

chosen.text: The team of Zhu Linjing and Shen Junfei, master students from the School of Optoelectronic Science and Engineering, started a new idea in the defects of traditional surgical lights and invented the smart LED shadowless surgical lamp.

src: “很多疾病早期检测、切除不到位，跟医生手术室用的灯有关 。 ”

chosen.text: Shen Junfei said that for example, when cancer is detected early, if doctors cannot see all tumor tissues in time, then cancer cells will still spread.

src: 这种智能手术灯已经在浙江大学医学院附属邵逸夫医院、浙江大学医学院附属儿童医院等医院试用，得到较好的反馈。

chosen.text: The module is a hollow structure. After the combination of the module, the vertical holes are connected and the horizontal holes are penetrated. src: 重庆中职学校试点现代学徒制 入学即是企业准员工-新华网

chosen.text: Chongqing Vocational Schools Pilot Modern Apprenticeship System, Students Become Employees After Enrollment - Xinhuanet

src: 昨天，记者从市教委获悉，今年起，我市将在60所中职学校试点“现代学徒制”人才培养模式，接受试点培养的学生同时具备学徒身份，招生录入后将被试点企业预录为单位员工。

chosen.text: Yesterday, the reporter learned from the Municipal Education Commission that starting from this year, our city will pilot the "modern apprenticeship" talent training model in 60 secondary vocational schools. Students who are trained in the pilot will have the status of apprentices and will be pre-recorded as unit employees by the pilot enterprises after enrollment.

src: 市教委要求，规范中职学校招生录取和企业用工程序，明确学徒的中职学校学生和企业准员工双重身份，按照双向选择原则，学徒、学校和企业签订三方协议，对于年满16周岁未达到18周岁的学徒，须由学徒、监护人、学校和企业四方签订协议，确定各方权益及学徒在岗培养的具体岗位、教学内容、权益保障等。

chosen.text: The Municipal Education Commission requires that the enrollment and admission of secondary vocational schools and the employment procedures of enterprises should be standardized, the dual identities of apprentices as students in secondary vocational schools and quasi-employees of enterprises should be clarified, and the apprentices, schools and enterprises should sign a tripartite agreement according to the principle of two-way selection. For apprentices who are over 16 years old but under 18 years old, the apprentices, guardians, schools and enterprises should sign an agreement to determine the rights and interests of all parties and the specific positions, teaching content, rights and interests protection, etc. of apprentices on the job.

src: 鼓励试点学校采用现代学徒制形式与合作企业联合开展企业员工岗前培训和转岗培训。

chosen.text: Pilot schools are encouraged to adopt the modern apprenticeship system and jointly carry out pre-job training and post-position training for enterprise employees with cooperative enterprises.

src: 试点学校要改革人才培养模式。

chosen.text: The pilot schools should reform the talent training model.

src: 校企共同设计人才培养方案，共同制订专业教学标准、课程标准、岗位标准、企业师傅标准、质量监控标准及相应实施方案。

chosen.text: The school and the enterprise jointly design talent training programs, jointly establish professional teaching standards, curriculum standards, post standards, enterprise master standards, quality control standards and corresponding implementation plans.

src: 试点以培养学制为一个试点周期，学生在企业的实习时间根据专业人才培养方案确定，顶岗实习一般为6个月。

chosen.text: The pilot is carried out in one cycle of training, and the internship time of students in enterprises is determined according to the professional talent training plan. The on-the-job internship is generally six months.

src: 在企业实践应实施企业班组化管理模式，根据不同专业的特点，1个师傅可带2～5个徒弟，组成学习小组，确保学生熟练掌握每个轮训岗位所需的技能。

chosen.text: In enterprise practice, the enterprise team management model should be implemented. According to the characteristics of different majors, one master can take 2-5 apprentices to form a study group to ensure that students are proficient in the skills required for each rotation training post.

src: 根据安排，从2016年起到2019年8月，我市分三批确定60个市级中职现代学徒制试点，每个试点人数在50人左右，总共培养3000名左右学生（学徒 ） 。

chosen.text: According to the arrangement, from 2016 to August 2019, our city will determine 60 municipal-level vocational schools in three batches to carry out the modern apprenticeship system pilot, with about 50 people in each pilot, and a total of about 3,000 students (apprentices).

src: 按照先试点再推行，由点到面逐步推进的原则，探索建立校企联合招生、联合培养、一体化育人的长效机制，切实提升学生岗位技能，提高学生对口就业率和就业质量。

chosen.text: In accordance with the principle of piloting first and then implementing, from point to surface, gradually promoting, explore the establishment of long-term mechanism for joint recruitment, joint training, and integrated education between schools and enterprises, and effectively improve students' job skills, and improve the employment rate and quality of students.

src: 据了解，中国儿童中心今年“六一”儿童节期间举办的活动包括“爱家创酷”儿童未来学习嘉年华、首届儿童视觉艺术节 、 “ 书香嘉年华”活动 、 “ 全家爱阅读”绘本系列活动等。

chosen.text: It is understood that the activities held by China Children's Center during this year's "Children's Day" include "Love Home and Create Coolness" Children's Future Learning Carnival, the First Children's Visual Art Festival, "Book Fair", "Family Love Reading" picture book series, etc.

src: 中国儿童中心副主任李忠明在２０日举行的２０１６年“六一”儿童节媒体通气会上介绍说 ， “ 爱家创酷”儿童未来学习嘉年华是今年中国儿童中心庆“六一”的重点活动。

chosen.text: Li Zhongming, deputy director of the China National Children's Center, said at the media briefing for the 2016 "June 1" Children's Day held on the 20th that the "Love Home and Create Cool" Children's Future Learning Carnival is a key event for the China National Children's Center to celebrate "June 1" this year.

src: 活动着眼于将社会创新与家庭个人创意有机结合，通过儿童和家庭参与体验各种创新教育活动，让创新实践成为大众家庭的文化基因，让“动手做”成为广大家庭新的学习和生活方式。

chosen.text: The event focuses on combining social innovation with family and personal creativity, and through children and families participating in various innovative educational activities, it makes innovation practice become the cultural gene of the mass family, and makes "do it yourself" become a new learning and lifestyle for many families.

src: 南非医生：奥密克戎传播力虽强 但多为轻症

chosen.text: South African doctor: Omicron is highly contagious, but most are mild cases

src: 南非许多医生和医疗专家认为，新冠病毒奥密克戎变种所致病症比德尔塔变种更为轻微，虽然传播速度更快。

chosen.text: Many doctors and medical experts in South Africa believe that the symptoms caused by the Omicron variant of coronavirus are milder than those caused by the Delta variant, although it spreads faster.

src: 据美联社报道，随着奥密克戎变种在南非的传播，南非豪登省的一个五千多名医生组成医师组织报告说，他们目前治疗的新冠病人出现的症状都比较轻微，例如身体疼痛和咳嗽等与流感类似的症状。

chosen.text: According to the Associated Press, as the Omicron variant spreads in South Africa, a medical organization composed of more than 5,000 doctors in Gauteng Province reported that the symptoms of the COVID-19 patients they currently treat are relatively mild, such as body pain and cough, which are similar to flu symptoms.

src: 该组织总监安本·皮莱（Unben Pillay）医生说，他每天都要看几十名病人，但是还没有任何病人需要住院。

chosen.text: Dr Unben Pillay, the organisation's director, said he sees dozens of patients every day but none of them have been hospitalised.

src: 皮莱说 ： “ 他们能够在家里控制疾病，大多数人在隔离10至14天内康复 。 ”

chosen.text: Pillay said, "They can control the disease at home, and most people recover within 10 to 14 days of isolation. "

src: 他说，这包括老年患者和那些有健康问题的患者，这些人群本来更容易因冠状病毒感染而陷入重症。

chosen.text: He said this includes elderly patients and those with underlying health conditions, who are more likely to become seriously ill from the coronavirus infection.

src: 他说，与之相比，在上一波的德尔塔疫情中，他治疗的新冠患者“呼吸困难，血氧水平低。

chosen.text: He said that in comparison, during the last wave of Delta infections, he treated COVID-19 patients who "were struggling to breathe and had low oxygen levels.

src: 许多人几天内就要住院 ” 。

chosen.text: Many people will be hospitalized within a few days. "

src: 在南部非洲首次报告奥密克戎变异毒株后的两周内，其他医生也分享了类似的经验。

chosen.text: Within two weeks of the first report of the Omicron variant in southern Africa, other doctors shared similar experiences.

src: 虽然收集足够的数据还需要几个星期的时间，但医生的观察和早期证据提供了一些线索。

chosen.text: Although it will take several weeks to collect enough data, doctors' observations and early evidence provide some clues.

src: 据南非国家传染病研究所总结：在近几周住院的新冠患者中，只有30%是严重病症，是前一波疫情重症比例的一半；平均住院时间从8天缩短到2.8天；近期的新冠患者中，仅有3%死亡，而在南非早期爆发的病例中，死亡比例达20 % 。

chosen.text: According to the summary of the National Institute for Communicable Diseases of South Africa: among the COVID-19 patients who were hospitalized in recent weeks, only 30% were serious cases, which was half of the proportion of serious cases in the previous wave; the average hospital stay was shortened from 8 days to 2.8 days; among the recent COVID-19 patients, only 3% died, while the death rate was 20% in the early outbreak cases in South Africa.

src: 非洲健康研究所所长威廉·哈内科姆（Willem Hanekom）引用国家传染病研究所的数据和其他报告说 ： “ 目前，几乎所有的迹象都表明，这是一种较温和的疾病 。 ”

chosen.text: According to data from the National Institute for Infectious Diseases and other reports, Willem Hanekom, director of the African Health Research Institute, said, "At present, almost all signs indicate that this is a mild disease. "

src: 他还说 ： “ 现在还是早期，我们需要获得后期数据。

chosen.text: He also said, "It is still early and we need to get later data.

src: 通常情况下，住院和死亡发生的时间较晚，而我们进入这一波疫情的时间只有两周 。 ”

chosen.text: Usually, hospitalization and death occur later, and we have been in this wave of the epidemic for only two weeks. "

src: 与此同时，世界各地的科学家正在观察病例数和住院率，同时测试目前的疫苗和治疗方法的效果。

chosen.text: Meanwhile, scientists around the world are watching case numbers and hospitalization rates while testing the effectiveness of current vaccines and treatments.

src: 尽管德尔塔仍然是全世界主要的新冠病毒株，但奥密克戎病例正在数十个国家出现，其中南非为疫情中心。

chosen.text: Although Delta remains the dominant strain of the virus worldwide, Omicron cases are emerging in dozens of countries, with South Africa at the epicenter of the outbreak.

src: 据卫生官员介绍，豪登省在12月的第一周发现的新病例增加了400 % ， 测试显示，奥密克戎变体的病例占90%以上。

chosen.text: Gauteng has seen a 400% increase in new cases in the first week of December, with more than 90% of cases now testing positive for the Omicron variant, health officials said.

src: 教育时评:拯救被拐儿童要靠什么？

chosen.text: Education commentary: What can be done to save abducted children?

src: 如果类比“没有买卖就没有杀害”的著名公益广告语，那么，在没有“收拐”需求的良好环境里，群防群治、全民反拐，使拐卖行为无利可图、风险大、成本高，这类犯罪也就不会屡屡发生。

chosen.text: If we compare it with the famous public service advertisement slogan of "no buying, no killing", then in an environment without the demand for "kidnapping", the prevention and control of kidnapping, and the prevention of kidnapping by all people will make the act of trafficking in persons unprofitable, risky and costly, so this kind of crime will not happen repeatedly.

src: 近日，公安部刑事侦查局打拐办开发的儿童失踪信息紧急发布平台上线。

chosen.text: Recently, the Missing Children Emergency Release Platform developed by the Anti-Abduction Office of the Criminal Investigation Bureau of the Ministry of Public Security was launched.

src: 这是为建立儿童失踪信息发布的权威渠道、及时找回被拐儿童而创设的互联网信息平台。

chosen.text: This is an Internet information platform created for the establishment of an authoritative channel for the release of information on missing children and the timely recovery of abducted children.

src: 听闻此App名为“团圆 ” ， 顿觉暖意十足。

chosen.text: Upon hearing that the name of this app is “Tuan Yuan”, I felt warm.

src: 新技术手段不仅名称“文艺 ” 、 情怀满满，而且信息化运用得当，实用、有效。

chosen.text: The new technology is not only named “literary and artistic” and full of sentiment, but also properly applied in information technology, practical and effective.

src: 打拐执法，首要目标是寻回被拐的孩子，保护其人身安全、自由。

chosen.text: The primary goal of anti-abduction law enforcement is to find abducted children and protect their personal safety and freedom.

src: 其次才是对嫌疑人的审判与惩罚。

chosen.text: Secondly, the trial and punishment of the suspects.

src: 刑事惩罚的意义，从个别惩罚、社会预防到法律教育，可以列举很多“大词 ” 。

chosen.text: The significance of criminal punishment can be listed as many "big words" from individual punishment, social prevention to legal education.

src: 但在拐卖案件告破之前，应优先关注被害人的人身安全。

chosen.text: However, before the trafficking case is solved, priority should be given to the personal safety of the victims.

src: 事分轻重缓急，在急切的“寻救”目的之下，诸如“拐卖儿童是否应当一律死刑”之类众说纷纭、争议较大的话题，可以暂搁下来，谨慎讨论；但救助被拐儿童的事情等不得。

chosen.text: Things have their priorities. In the urgent "rescue" purpose, topics such as "whether the death penalty should be imposed on all cases of child trafficking" can be put aside for cautious discussion; but the rescue of trafficked children cannot wait.

src: 根据此类案件的侦办经验，人贩子惯于在得手之后尽快远离作案地点。

chosen.text: According to the experience of investigating such cases, human traffickers are accustomed to leaving the scene of the crime as soon as possible after they succeed.

src: 寻拐行动多耽搁一分钟，孩子就可能更远离家长一步，案件侦破的难度也就增加一分。

chosen.text: The longer the search and rescue operation takes, the further the child may be from his parents, and the more difficult it is to solve the case.

src: 在此情况下，拿出如“团圆”平台这样直接有助于侦破案件、寻回孩子的有效办法，确实是务实的行动。

chosen.text: In this case, it is a practical action to come up with an effective method such as the "reunion" platform, which can directly help to solve the case and find the child.

src: 毕竟 ， “ 打拐”是需要运作起整个法制系统来做好的一件大任务。

chosen.text: After all, "anti-abduction" is a major task that requires the entire legal system to be put into operation.

src: 打击犯罪、保障儿童和家长权益，从立法的完善，到司法的保障，以及执法的缜密，无不需要贯彻“护幼扶弱”的关怀。

chosen.text: To combat crime and safeguard the interests of children and parents, from the improvement of legislation to the guarantee of justice and the meticulousness of law enforcement, all need to implement the care of "protecting the young and helping the weak".

src: 此外，拐卖儿童的预防，从家庭到社会，都还可以做得更好。

chosen.text: In addition, the prevention of child trafficking can be improved from family to society.

src: 比如一个常见的案例，一家三口在火车站休息，父母熟睡，醒来才发现孩子不见了。

chosen.text: For example, a common case is that a family of three rests at the railway station. The parents are fast asleep and wake up to find that their child has disappeared.

src: 不能期待一个两岁的孩子具有足够的自我保护技能，但作为年幼孩子的家长，应至少具有相当的保护意识。

chosen.text: A two-year-old cannot be expected to have sufficient self-protection skills, but as a parent of a young child, you should at least have a reasonable awareness of protection.

src: 父母两人轮流休息，又或将孩子置于稳妥的保护之下，都是预防儿童被拐的最起码手段。

chosen.text: Parents should take turns to rest or put children in safe protection, which is the minimum means of preventing children from being kidnapped.

src: 从警方打击拐卖犯罪的另一面看，购买被拐儿童一方也应被关注和惩治。

chosen.text: From another aspect of the police's fight against trafficking crimes, the side that purchases abducted children should also be concerned and punished.

src: 单个的不法行为，往往只是长长链条中的一环。

chosen.text: A single act of wrongdoing is often just one link in a long chain.

src: 根据我国《刑法》规定，拐卖儿童罪的法定刑起刑点为5年；情节特别严重的，可至死刑，并处没收财产。

chosen.text: According to China's Criminal Law, the legal penalty for the crime of child trafficking is 5 years; in cases of especially serious circumstances, the penalty may be death and confiscation of property.

src: 起刑点高、最高刑重，在“轻刑化”的大趋势下，拐卖儿童罪显然属于处罚较重的罪。

chosen.text: The starting point of the sentence is high, and the maximum sentence is heavy. In the general trend of "lightening the sentence", the crime of abducting children is obviously a crime with a heavy sentence.

src: 可至今每年仍还有不少的拐卖案件发生。

chosen.text: However, there are still many cases of human trafficking every year.

src: 可见，部分人在养育儿女方面的观念落后，法律意识淡薄。

chosen.text: It can be seen that some people have backward concepts in raising children and weak legal awareness.

src: 对这部分人的法制教育应该同步跟进。

chosen.text: The legal education of this group should be carried out in parallel.

src: 要有效控制拐卖犯罪，不能仅靠官方严格执法。

chosen.text: To effectively control trafficking crimes, it is not enough to rely on strict law enforcement by the government.

src: 倘若收拐“市场”广泛存在，拐卖者利欲熏心，不断创新拐卖手段，形成与执法者的“斗法”局面，打拐行动势必会陷入低效的泥淖。

chosen.text: If the "market" of abduction is widespread, the abductors are greedy and constantly innovate the means of abduction, forming a "duel" situation with the law enforcement, the anti-abduction action will inevitably fall into the inefficient quagmire.

src: 因此，破除落后观念，普及法律常识，也有助于根治拐卖、收买儿童犯罪。

chosen.text: Therefore, breaking away from backward ideas and popularizing legal knowledge will also help to eradicate the crime of child trafficking and buying.

src: 湖南日报12月10日讯（全媒体记者 龚柏威）根据省委统一安排，12月10日上午，省委常委、省委宣传部部长杨浩东在马栏山视频文创园作互动宣讲，深入学习贯彻党的十九届六中全会精神，学习贯彻习近平总书记对湖南重要讲话重要指示批示精神，学习贯彻省第十二次党代会精神。

chosen.text: Hunan Daily, December 10 (All-media reporter Gong Baiwei) According to the unified arrangement of the Provincial Party Committee, Yang Haodong, member of the Standing Committee of the Provincial Party Committee and head of the Propaganda Department of the Provincial Party Committee, gave an interactive presentation in Malanshan Video Cultural and Creative Park on the morning of December 10, to thoroughly study and implement the spirit of the Sixth Plenary Session of the 19th CPC Central Committee, the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speeches, instructions and directives for Hunan, and the spirit of the 12th Provincial Party Congress.

src: 杨浩东从理想信念与初心使命、自我革命与青春大党、党的领袖和党的理论等三个方面，结合自身感悟、亲身经历，深入浅出、全面系统地阐释了全会精神的核心要义和实践要求。

chosen.text: Yang Haodong explained the core essence and practical requirements of the spirit of the plenary session in a simple and comprehensive manner, from three aspects, namely, ideals and beliefs and original mission, self-revolution and youth party, and the party's leader and the party's theory, combined with his own insights and personal experiences.

src: 他指出，要将全会精神和习近平总书记对湖南重要讲话重要指示批示精神、省党代会精神结合起来学，融会贯通学，增强捍卫“两个确立 ” 、 做到“两个维护”的思想自觉、政治自觉、行动自觉，坚定不移沿着习近平总书记指引的方向前进。

chosen.text: He pointed out that the spirit of the plenary session and the spirit of the important speech and important instructions of General Secretary Xi Jinping to Hunan, as well as the spirit of the Provincial Party Congress, should be studied together, and that the spirit should be studied in a comprehensive and integrated manner, so as to enhance the ideological awareness, political awareness, and action awareness of upholding the “two major establishments” and achieving the “two major safeguards”, and to move forward unwaveringly in the direction pointed out by General Secretary Xi Jinping.

src: 在互动交流环节，基层干部代表、企业代表、青年代表就三个历史决议的关系、如何理解“两个确立”的决定性意义、文化企业如何把握导向、新时代青年如何从百年党史中汲取力量等进行了提问，杨浩东以通俗的语言、生动的事例一一解答，他殷殷寄语青年党员，要从党的百年奋斗史中，汲取奋进的力量，紧密团结在党中央周围，坚定不移跟党走,用青春奉献书写责任和担当。

chosen.text: During the interactive session, representatives of grass-roots cadres, enterprises and young people asked questions about the relationship between the three historical resolutions, how to understand the decisive significance of "two establishments", how cultural enterprises should grasp the orientation, and how young people in the new era should draw strength from the century-long history of the Party. Yang Haodong answered these questions one by one with popular language and vivid examples. He earnestly told young party members that they should draw the power to forge ahead from the century-long struggle history of the Party, closely unite around the Party Central Committee, unswervingly follow the Party, and write their responsibilities and commitments with their youth.

src: 2022年北京地区高校毕业生预计达26.8万人-新华网

chosen.text: The number of graduates from universities and colleges in Beijing is expected to reach 268,000 in 2022 - Xinhuanet

src: 新华社北京12月11日电（记者阳娜）记者从近日北京市教委、北京市人力资源和社会保障局联合召开的2022届北京高校毕业生就业创业工作视频会议上获悉，2022年北京地区高校毕业生预计达26.8万人，比去年增加1.6万人。

chosen.text: Xinhua News Agency, Beijing, December 11 (Reporter Yang Na) - The reporter learned from the video conference on employment and entrepreneurship of graduates in 2022 held recently by the Beijing Municipal Education Commission and the Beijing Municipal Human Resources and Social Security Bureau that the number of college graduates in Beijing is expected to reach 268,000 in 2022, an increase of 16,000 over last year.

src: 北京市人力资源和社会保障局相关负责人表示，将从加强供需匹配、强化政策支持、拓宽就业渠道、确保困难帮扶、支持创新创业、提升服务效能等方面部署北京高校毕业生就业工作。

chosen.text: According to the relevant person in charge of Beijing Human Resources and Social Security Bureau, Beijing will deploy the employment work for college graduates from aspects such as strengthening supply and demand matching, strengthening policy support, broadening employment channels, ensuring assistance to the needy, supporting innovation and entrepreneurship, and improving service efficiency.

src: 记者了解到，北京市人力资源和社会保障局将搭建实践平台，加大岗位供给，主动联系40家高校毕业生职场体验基地，走访用人单位，整合需求信息和岗位信息；重点抓好“六个一批 ” ， 即拓宽事业单位招录一批，拓宽国有企业招聘一批，拓宽基层项目招募一批，拓宽应征入伍一批，拓宽就业见习留用一批，拓宽创业带动就业一批；实行“一生一策”动态管理，为每位毕业生推荐不少于5个岗位信息，确保有就业意愿的困难家庭毕业生100%实现帮扶等。

chosen.text: The reporter learned that the Beijing Municipal Human Resources and Social Security Bureau will build a practice platform, increase job supply, take the initiative to contact 40 workplace experience bases for college graduates, visit employers, and integrate demand information and job information; focus on "six batches", namely, expand the recruitment of public institutions, expand the recruitment of state-owned enterprises, expand the recruitment of grass-roots projects, expand the recruitment of conscripts, expand the employment probation and retention, and expand the entrepreneurship-driven employment; implement "one policy for one life" dynamic management, recommend no less than 5 job information for each graduate, and ensure that 100% of the graduates from poor families who are willing to work will be helped.

src: 国际橄榄油协会将橄榄油分为初榨橄榄油（Virgin Olive Oil）和精炼橄榄油（Lampante Olive Oil或Refined Olive Oil）两大类，五个级别。

chosen.text: The International Olive Oil Council classifies olive oil into two major categories, virgin olive oil and lampante olive oil or refined olive oil, with five levels.

src: 初榨橄榄油或称为天然橄榄油，是直接从新鲜的橄榄果实中采取机械冷榨、经过过滤等处理除去异物后得到的油脂。

chosen.text: Virgin olive oil, also known as natural olive oil, is the oil obtained directly from fresh olives by mechanical cold pressing and then filtered to remove impurities.

src: 根据酸度的不同可分为三个级别：

chosen.text: They are divided into three levels according to their acidity:

src: 特级初榨橄榄油（Extra Virgin）：是最高级别、质量最高的橄榄油，是纯天然产品。

chosen.text: Extra Virgin Olive Oil: It is the highest grade and highest quality olive oil, which is a natural product.

src: 口味绝佳，有淡雅怡人的植物芬芳，酸度不超过1%。

chosen.text: It has a great taste with a delicate and pleasant plant fragrance, and an acid content of less than 1%.

src: 优质初榨橄榄油（Fine Virgin）：酸度稍高，但不超过2%，味道纯正、芳香。

chosen.text: Fine Virgin: Slightly higher acidity, but not more than 2%, pure and fragrant.

src: 普通初榨橄榄油（Ordinary Virgin）：口味与风味尚可，酸度不超过3.3%。

chosen.text: Ordinary Virgin: The taste and flavor are still acceptable, with an acid content not exceeding 3.3%.

src: 精炼橄榄油是指酸度超过3.3%的初榨橄榄油精炼后所得到的橄榄油，或成为“二次油”。

chosen.text: Refined olive oil is the olive oil obtained from the refining of virgin olive oil with an acid content above 3.3%, or "second oil".

src: 精炼橄榄油可分为两个级别：

chosen.text: Refined olive oil is divided into two grades:

src: 普通橄榄油（Olive Oil）：精炼橄榄油与一定比例的初榨橄榄油混合，以调和味道与颜色，其酸度在1.5%以下，呈透明的淡金黄色。

chosen.text: Olive Oil: Refined olive oil mixed with a certain proportion of extra virgin olive oil to blend the taste and color, with acidity below 1.5%, is transparent light golden yellow.

src: 精炼橄榄杂质油或橄榄果渣油（Refined Olive-Pomace Oil）：是通过溶解法从油渣中提取并经过精炼而得到的橄榄油。

chosen.text: Refined olive-pomace oil: is extracted from the pomace by dissolution and refined to obtain olive oil.

src: 看过等级分类的你应该已经发现，橄榄油的酸度是一个非常重要的指标。

chosen.text: You should have noticed by now that the acidity of olive oil is a very important indicator, as per the classification.

src: 要知道，橄榄果就好像酿制葡萄酒的葡萄一样，来自不同的产区、不同橄榄果品种的橄榄果，就会出产不同标准的橄榄油。

chosen.text: It should be noted that olives are like grapes used to make wine, and different standards of olive oil will be produced from different regions and different varieties of olives.

src: 油橄榄的最佳生长地：

chosen.text: The best place to grow olive oil:

src: 地中海沿岸具有油橄榄生长所需的最适宜的土壤和气温、日照、空气湿度以及降水量等气候条件。

chosen.text: The Mediterranean coast has the most suitable soil and climate conditions such as temperature, sunshine, air humidity and precipitation required for the growth of oil olives.

src: 除地中海沿岸外，其它地区只能在适生区零星种植。

chosen.text: Except for the Mediterranean coast, other areas can only be sporadically planted in suitable areas.

src: 主要产区产地（地中海）：

chosen.text: Main production areas (Mediterranean):

src: 意大利、西班牙、希腊、土耳其、葡萄牙、摩洛哥、叙利亚、以色列、突尼斯、阿尔及利亚、埃及、巴基斯坦、黎巴嫩等等，与其气候类似的也有远在南纬度的阿根廷、秘鲁、南非等等。

chosen.text: Italy, Spain, Greece, Turkey, Portugal, Morocco, Syria, Israel, Tunisia, Algeria, Egypt, Pakistan, Lebanon, and so on, and those with similar climate in the far south latitude, such as Argentina, Peru, South Africa and so on.

src: 油橄榄的采摘月份：

chosen.text: Olive harvesting month:

src: 每年的3至6月，是油橄榄树开花坐果的时间，7至10月果实开始发育并且成熟，果实从绿色过渡到红色，紫色，最后变黑。

chosen.text: From March to June every year, it is the time for the olive tree to bloom and bear fruit. From July to October, the fruits begin to develop and mature, and the fruits transition from green to red, purple, and finally black.

src: 11月至次年2月是果实的采摘季节（橄榄油的新鲜度可是很重要的哦）。

chosen.text: The fruit is picked from November to February of the next year (the freshness of olive oil is very important).

src: 橄榄油的营养成分：

chosen.text: Nutritional composition of olive oil:

src: 橄榄油富含丰富的单不饱和脂肪酸，即油酸及亚油酸、亚麻酸，还有维生素A、维生素B、维生素D、维生素E、维生素K及抗氧化物等。

chosen.text: Olive oil is rich in monounsaturated fatty acids, i.e., oleic acid and linoleic acid, linolenic acid, as well as vitamin A, vitamin B, vitamin D, vitamin E, vitamin K and antioxidants.

src: 橄榄油被认为是迄今所发现的油脂中最适合人体营养的油。

chosen.text: Olive oil is considered to be the most suitable oil for human nutrition among all oils discovered so far.

src: 民主峰会落幕，拜登称自由之火永不熄灭

chosen.text: Biden says 'fire of freedom' will never be extinguished as democracy summit ends

src: 由美国总统拜登召集、有全球110个国家的政府以及公民社会和私营部门领导人出席的线上“民主峰会 ” ( Summit for Democracy)星期五（12月10日）落幕。

chosen.text: The online "Summit for Democracy" convened by US President Biden and attended by government leaders, civil society and private sector leaders from 110 countries around the world ended on Friday (December 10).

src: 拜登在闭幕词中说，自由之火在世界每个人的心中燃烧，专制政权永远无法将其熄灭。

chosen.text: The torch of freedom burns in everyone's heart around the world, and authoritarian regimes can never extinguish it, Biden said in his closing remarks.

src: 他也表示，计划明年召开第二届全球“民主峰会 ” 。

chosen.text: He also said that he planned to hold the second global "Democracy Summit" next year.

src: 台湾政府代表、政务委员唐凤和目前流亡英国的香港民主人权活动人士罗冠聪也在第二天的峰会上发言。

chosen.text: Tang Fenghe, a representative of the Taiwan government and a member of the Executive Yuan, and Luo Guansheng, a Hong Kong pro-democracy and human rights activist currently in exile in the UK, also spoke at the summit on the second day.

src: 拜登说 ： “ 我们知道摆在我们面前的工作是多么的艰巨。

chosen.text: Biden said, "We know how difficult the work ahead of us is.

src: 但我们也知道，我们可以迎接挑战，因为我以前说过，正如这次峰会所表明的，民主世界无处不在。

chosen.text: But we also know that we can meet the challenge, because as I have said before, and as this summit has shown, the democratic world is everywhere.

src: 专制政权永远无法熄灭自由的微火，它在全世界和世界各地人们的心中燃烧 。 ”

chosen.text: The dictatorship can never extinguish the small fire of freedom, which burns in the world and in the hearts of people all over the world. "

src: 拜登还表示，捍卫民主需要整个社会的共同努力。

chosen.text: Biden also said that defending democracy requires the joint efforts of the whole society.

src: 他说 ： “ 作为政府的领导人，我们有责任倾听我们的公民，加固民主的护栏，推动改革，实现透明的问责治理，更能抵御专制的缓冲和冲击的力量，以及那些想在公共利益之前赤裸裸地追求权力的人 。 ”

chosen.text: He said, "As leaders of the government, we have a responsibility to listen to our citizens, strengthen the guardrails of democracy, promote reform, achieve transparent accountability governance, and be more resistant to the buffer and impact of autocracy, as well as those who want to pursue power nakedly before the public interest. "

src: “民主峰会”第二天的主题分别是捍卫人权，巩固民主与对抗威权，以及反击数字威权主义与肯定民主价值。

chosen.text: The themes of the second day of the "Democracy Summit" are defending human rights, consolidating democracy and confronting authoritarianism, as well as countering digital authoritarianism and affirming democratic values.

src: 这一天恰逢“国际人权日 ” 。

chosen.text: This day coincides with "International Human Rights Day".

src: 联合国秘书长古特雷斯在当天的开场讲话中也表示，民主事业在全球面临挑战，特别是新兴数字技术带来的挑战。

chosen.text: In his opening remarks, UN Secretary-General Guterres also said that the cause of democracy faces challenges globally, especially those brought about by emerging digital technologies.

src: 他说 ： “ 现在是重申共同价值观和立场以及民主韧性的时候了。

chosen.text: He said, "It is time to reaffirm common values and positions as well as democratic resilience.

src: 这需要深化社会对话，解决不平等问题，打击腐败，更新社会契约，为优质教育投资，并扩大妇女和女童的机会。

chosen.text: This requires deepening social dialogue, addressing inequality, fighting corruption, renewing the social contract, investing in quality education and expanding opportunities for women and girls.

src: 这也需要坚决谴责一切形式的民粹主义、本土主义和极端主义，包括利用技术革命所提供的所有工具 。 ”

chosen.text: This also requires a firm condemnation of all forms of populism, nativism and extremism, including those that exploit all the tools provided by technological revolution. "

src: 香港民主人权活动人士罗冠聪通过预先录制的视频对峰会发表讲话，提醒与会者持续关注香港和维吾尔族和藏族等中国少数民族的人权状况。

chosen.text: Hong Kong pro-democracy and human rights activist Luo Guansheng addressed the summit through a pre-recorded video, reminding participants to continue to pay attention to the human rights situation in Hong Kong and ethnic minorities in China such as Uyghurs and Tibetans.

src: 他说 ： “ 长期以来，世界一直接受中国的崛起，却没有建立一个机制来对其进行问责。

chosen.text: He said, "For a long time, the world has been accepting China's rise, but has not established a mechanism to hold it accountable.

src: 这就是为什么政治人物和民间社会领导人必须合作。

chosen.text: This is why politicians and civil society leaders must work together.

src: 我们必须利用我们所拥有的一切（资源）来确保民主的复兴是我们的首要任务 。 ”

chosen.text: We must use everything we have (resources) to ensure that the revival of democracy is our top priority. "

src: 罗冠聪也呼吁自由世界团结起来对抗中共的威胁。

chosen.text: Lo also called on the free world to unite against the threat of the CCP.

src: 他说 ： “ 也许你们中的一些人害怕惹恼习近平总书记，也许你们中的一些人不想失去中国市场，也许你们中的一些人没有认识到（中共）对我们民主价值观的威胁。

chosen.text: He said, "Maybe some of you are afraid to upset General Secretary Xi Jinping, maybe some of you don't want to lose the Chinese market, maybe some of you don't realize the threat (of the CCP) to our democratic values.

src: 而这就是我们失败的原因。

chosen.text: And that's why we failed.

src: 这也是我们必须改变的原因 。 ”

chosen.text: This is also the reason why we must change. "

src: 台湾行政院政务委员唐凤在出席“打击数字独裁主义，肯定民主价值”的圆桌讨论中，通过视频发布《国家声明 》 ， 强调台湾站在对抗专制和威权的最前线。

chosen.text: Tang Feng, a member of the Executive Yuan of Taiwan, delivered a video-recorded “National Statement” at the round-table discussion on “Combating Digital Authoritarianism and Upholding Democratic Values”, stressing that Taiwan is at the forefront of the fight against dictatorship and authoritarianism.

src: 他也分享了如何通过信息透明与构建互信来抗击新冠疫情的经验。

chosen.text: He also shared his experience on how to fight the COVID-19 epidemic through information transparency and building mutual trust.

src: 他说 ： “ 在台湾的民主方兴未艾之际，我们始终坚定站在全球对抗威权主义的最前线，更在促进全球自由、民主和人权上，扮演领导角色。

chosen.text: He said, "At a time when Taiwan's democracy is still in its infancy, we have always stood firmly at the forefront of the global fight against authoritarianism, and we have played a leading role in promoting global freedom, democracy, and human rights.

src: 于疫情期间，各地的威权政府以公共卫生和集体利益为名，合理化侵犯人权的行为，全球民主呈现倒退的迹象。

chosen.text: During the pandemic, authoritarian governments around the world have rationalized human rights violations in the name of public health and collective interest, and there are signs that global democracy has regressed.

src: 然而在台湾，我们不必封城就能控制疫情，不必下架就能战胜假信息 。 ”

chosen.text: However, in Taiwan, we can control the epidemic without sealing off cities and defeat false information without taking them down. "

src: 就在“民主峰会”第二天日程进行的同时，美国财政部宣布对被认定严重侵犯人权的中国、朝鲜等几个国家的15名个人、10个实体依法实施制裁，同时对一家被认定利用监视技术协助侵犯人权的中国公司实施投资限制。

chosen.text: While the second day of the "democracy summit" was going on, the US Treasury Department announced that it would impose sanctions on 15 individuals and 10 entities in China, North Korea and other countries that were found to have seriously violated human rights, and imposed investment restrictions on a Chinese company that was found to have used surveillance technology to assist in the violation of human rights.

src: 江西３年内将培训万名乡村小学音体美教师-新华网

chosen.text: Jiangxi will train 10,000 rural primary school music, physical education and art teachers within three years - Xinhuanet

src: 新华社南昌５月２２日电（记者陈毓珊）记者近日从江西省教育厅获悉，为增强紧缺学科教师队伍保障能力，实现乡村义务教育均衡发展，自２０１６年起，江西省规划用３年时间为全省乡村（乡镇及以下）每所小学培训合格的音乐、美术、体育教师各１名，共计１万名。

chosen.text: Xinhua News Agency, Nanchang, May 22 (Reporter Chen Yushan) The reporter learned from the Jiangxi Provincial Department of Education that in order to enhance the guarantee ability of the shortage of teachers and achieve balanced development of rural compulsory education, since 2016, Jiangxi Province plans to train 1 qualified music teacher, 1 qualified art teacher and 1 qualified physical education teacher for each primary school in rural areas (townships and below) in the province within three years, totaling 10,000.

src: 据了解，这次培训对象为江西全省乡村小学４５岁以下具有音乐、美术、体育学科知识基础或才能，能兼任音乐、美术、体育课程的其他学科教师。

chosen.text: It is understood that this training was aimed at teachers in primary schools in rural areas of Jiangxi Province under 45 years old who have knowledge or talent in music, art and sports, and can also teach music, art and sports courses.

src: 通过培训，使他们掌握音体美学科教学的基本知识和教学技能，更新教学思想和观念，掌握现代教学方法，提高学科教学能力、活动设计能力、校园文化能力及自我发展能力，建设一支一专多能的音体美教师队伍，缓解乡村音体美教师缺乏的问题。

chosen.text: Through training, they will master the basic knowledge and teaching skills of music, physical education and art subjects, update their teaching ideas and concepts, master modern teaching methods, improve their ability to teach music, physical education and art, activity design ability, campus culture ability and self-development ability, build a team of teachers with one specialty and multiple abilities in music, physical education and art, and alleviate the problem of lack of music, physical education and art teachers in rural areas.

src: 为确保培训质量和效果，江西还规划为全省１００个县（市、区）小学音乐、美术、体育各培训１名，共计３００名培训者，全面提升他们的教学示范引领能力、教研活动设计组织能力、施训能力、网络研修工作坊建设能力，起到教授、示范、指导、监督的作用。

chosen.text: To ensure the quality and effect of the training, Jiangxi also plans to train 100 music, art and physical education teachers in 100 counties (cities and districts) in the province, a total of 300 trainers, to comprehensively improve their teaching demonstration leadership ability, teaching research activity design and organization ability, training ability, network research workshop construction ability, and to play the role of teaching, demonstration, guidance and supervision.

src: 第十八届“世界饮料创新奖”（World Beverage Innovation Awards）是FoodBev Media与德国纽伦堡国际啤酒、酿酒及饮料工业展览会（Brau Beviale）联合举办的奖项。

chosen.text: The 18th World Beverage Innovation Awards (WBIAs) is an award jointly organized by FoodBev Media and the International Beer, Brewing & Beverage Industry Exhibition in Nuremberg, Germany (Brau Beviale).

src: 吸引了来自25个国家、22个不同品类的279个作品参赛。

chosen.text: It attracted 279 works from 25 countries and 22 different categories.

src: 10月15日，决赛入围者名单公布，最终获奖者名单将于11月11日（英国夏令时）线上公布。

chosen.text: The finalists were announced on October 15 and the winner will be announced online on November 11 (British Summer Time).

src: 我们看到，元气森林的LP28无糖酸奶入围最佳乳饮料奖，伊利安慕希的“GOGO武汉”营销入围最佳营销活动，百事可乐和人民日报新媒体合作的包装还入围最佳包装设计/标签奖。

chosen.text: We saw that the LP28 sugar-free yogurt of Yuanqi Forest was shortlisted for the Best Dairy Drink Award, the “GOGO Wuhan” marketing of Yili Amulie was shortlisted for the Best Marketing Campaign, and the packaging of the cooperation between PepsiCo and People’s Daily New Media was also shortlisted for the Best Packaging Design/Label Award.

src: FoodBev Media高级市场营销总监Laura Nettle表示：我们很高兴与Brau Beviale一起庆祝年度世界饮料创新奖的第18年。

chosen.text: Laura Nettle, senior marketing director at FoodBev Media, said: "We are delighted to celebrate the 18th anniversary of the annual World Beverage Innovation Awards with Brau Beviale.

src: 从新口味、新概念和新功能到品牌、包装和制造，随着行业不断以更可持续的方式进行创新，我们看到了饮料行业的趋势。

chosen.text: From new flavours, concepts and functions to brands, packaging and manufacturing, we have seen trends in the beverage industry as the industry continues to innovate in more sustainable ways.

src: 前段时间有篇《快看！项目经理可冲击金牌的奥运项目》文章很火，里面提到项目经理们在很多项目上，绝对是可以一马当先，无人能匹： 搬砖、出差、熬夜是项目经理的日常，救火、背锅、道歉更是不在话下。

chosen.text: A few days ago, an article titled "Look! Project managers can win gold medals in Olympic events" was very popular. It mentioned that project managers could be the first in many projects and no one could match them: moving bricks, business trips, staying up late were the daily routine of project managers; fire fighting, taking the blame, apologizing were not a problem.

src: 看似玩笑调侃的一篇文章，却也道出了项目经理们的日常辛酸，背后代表的是对当前项目管理工作的力不从心。

chosen.text: An article that seems like a joke, but it also reveals the daily hardships of project managers, and behind it is the powerlessness of current project management work.

src: 而从事项目管理工作的人员，也渐渐选择通过一些行动来让自己摆脱工作中的困境。

chosen.text: And those who work in project management are gradually choosing to take some action to get themselves out of the dilemma in their work.

src: 从每年攀升的PMP（国际认证的项目管理专业人士资格）报名人数来看，越来越多的项目管理从业人员通过学习来提升自己的项目管理能力。

chosen.text: From the annual increase in PMP (International Certified Project Management Professional Qualification) registration numbers, it can be seen that more and more project management practitioners have improved their project management capabilities through learning.

src: 据《中国项目管理二十年发展报告(1999-2019)》称：截止到2019年9月，全国累计PMP®报考人数近60万人次，通过PMP®认证人数约42万人，有效持证人数约30万人, 占全球PMP®持证总量的31.2%。

chosen.text: According to the “Report on the Development of China’s Project Management in the Past 20 Years (1999-2019)”, as of September 2019, the cumulative number of PMP® applicants nationwide was nearly 600,000, the number of PMP® certified persons was about 420,000, and the number of valid certificate holders was about 300,000, accounting for 31.2% of the total number of PMP® certificates globally.

src: 近10年PMP持证人数逐年递增，这说明越来越多的项目管理者意识到：靠简单照搬以往“老经验”来做事已不可取，瞬息万变的工作环境让我们知道一个要学会，站在科学巨人的肩膀上去探索前行的道路。

chosen.text: In the past 10 years, the number of PMP certificate holders has increased year by year, which indicates that more and more project managers have realized that it is no longer possible to rely on simple copying of previous "old experience" to do things, and the ever-changing working environment tells us that we should learn how to stand on the shoulders of giants to explore the path ahead.

src: 然而，考了PMP就能保证项目管理工作畅通无阻了吗？

chosen.text: However, does obtaining a PMP certification guarantee smooth project management?

src: 很多项目管理初学者表示，通过学习PMP/IPMP等相关课程，可以系统性地掌握项目管理的十大领域和五大过程组等相关知识点，但真正进行项目管理工作的时候却还是一头雾水。

chosen.text: Many beginners in project management say that by studying PMP/IPMP and other related courses, they can systematically master the ten areas of project management and five process groups and other related knowledge points, but when they actually carry out project management work, they are still confused.

src: 很多项目经理常常反馈以下问题： 项目管理认知不到位，单纯依靠个人经验，空有项目管理理论，不知如何实践； 缺乏系统的项目管理流程制度支撑，工作中无法落地，项目预估不准，把控度灵敏度差，项目一拖再拖； 成员分工不明确、团队中的“老油条”不知如何应对 跨部门协助沟通不顺畅，项目难以推进 ……

chosen.text: Many project managers often feedback the following problems: the project management awareness is not in place, they simply rely on personal experience, and they have project management theory but do not know how to practice; there is no systematic project management process and system support, so it is impossible to implement the work, project estimation is inaccurate, and the control degree is poor, so the project is delayed again and again; the division of labor among members is unclear, and the “old oil” in the team does not know how to deal with it; the cross-departmental assistance communication is not smooth, and the project is difficult to promote...

src: 因此，专注产品创新与研发管理领域十余载，已帮助众多优秀的企业培养了大批的产品经理、项目经理等研发关键人才，并获得了 “中国企业研发管理人才培训示范基地”等荣誉称号的中天华夏咨询带着《研发项目经理特训营》线上课程来了。

chosen.text: Therefore, Zhongtian Huaxia Consulting, which has focused on product innovation and R&D management for more than a decade, has helped many excellent enterprises to train a large number of key R&D talents such as product managers and project managers, and has won honorary titles such as "China Enterprise R&D Management Talent Training Demonstration Base". It has brought the online course "R&D Project Manager Special Training Camp".

src: 《研发项目经理特训营》线上课程 这是一种线上碎片化学习的方式，结合了众多研发型企业的实战案例、工具和方法，帮助您掌握项目经理必备知识及标准动作，走上自身项目管理的进阶之路。

chosen.text: The online course of "Special Training Camp for R&D Project Managers" is a way of online fragmented learning. It combines the practical cases, tools and methods of many R&D enterprises to help you master the knowledge and standard actions required for project managers and take the advanced path of project management.

src: 这也是一次让企业用更低的成本和更少的投入，促进项目经理的培养进程，为企业带来高效运作结果的机会。

chosen.text: This is also an opportunity to promote the training process of project managers with lower costs and less investment, and bring high-efficiency operation results for enterprises.

src: 口说无凭，可以先看看其他学员怎么评价这门课程： 这门课程不仅是由中天华夏专家团队（原华为研发管理团队），结合国际先进的项目管理方法论和众多知名企业真实业务场景，对课程内容进行深入浅出的专业讲解。

chosen.text: Without evidence, you can first see how other students evaluate this course: This course is not only taught by Zhongtian Huaxia expert team (former Huawei R&D management team), combined with international advanced project management methodology and many well-known enterprises real business scenarios, to give a professional explanation of the course content in simple terms.

src: 更是会提供科学实用的管理工具与方法，丰富的模板表单，帮助学员在课后将学习的内容转化运用于具体工作。

chosen.text: The dazzling variety of discount red envelopes and the eye-catching live shopping have once again made consumers shout that they have benefited from it. On one hand, this wave of consumption has made people sigh at the growing national purchasing power, but on the other hand, it is also necessary to cool down and think about the impact of consumerism on society and contemporary mainstream consumers.

src: 在“双十二”到来前夕，捷信消费金融有限公司（以下简称“捷信 ” ） 发出理性消费倡导，提醒广大用户尤其是年轻人树立良好的消费意识与消费习惯，拒绝盲目消费与过度消费。

chosen.text: On the eve of “Singles’ Day”, Home Credit Consumer Finance Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as “Home Credit”) issued a rational consumption advocacy, reminding users, especially young people, to establish good consumption awareness and consumption habits, and to refuse blind consumption and excessive consumption.

src: 据人民银行今年发布的《消费者金融素养调查分析报告》结果显示，全国消费者金融素养指数为66.81，与2019年相比，提高2.04。

chosen.text: According to the results of the "Consumer Financial Literacy Survey and Analysis Report" released by the People's Bank of China this year, the national consumer financial literacy index is 66.81, which has increased by 2.04 compared with 2019.

src: 总体上，我国居民在金融消费层面上的表现较好，但在金融行为和技能的不同方面体现出较大的差异性，还需要进一步提升基础金融知识水平。

chosen.text: Overall, the performance of Chinese residents in financial consumption is relatively good, but there are significant differences in different aspects of financial behavior and skills, and the level of basic financial knowledge needs to be further improved.

src: 老年人和青少年的金融素养水平相对较低 ， “ 一老一少”仍将是金融教育持续关注的重点对象；尼尔森发布的《中国年轻人负债状况报告》及央视财经发布的《2019-2020中国青年消费报告》显示，年轻一代具有巨大的消费潜力，信用消费成为消费升级重要途径，86.6%的年轻人都在使用信贷产品，近半数人没有债务累积，年轻一代虽然整体呈现理性消费趋势，虽与外界贴上的“过度挥霍”标签大相径庭，但部分年轻人的确存在过度消费、跟风消费行为，并因此产生了过大的财务压力和债务风险，甚至导致社会问题逐渐增加，金融企业应勇于承担社会责任，进行正向引导。

chosen.text: The financial literacy of the elderly and young people is relatively low, and "the elderly and young" will still be the key objects of continuous attention in financial education; the "Report on the Debt Situation of Chinese Youth" released by Nielsen and the "2019-2020 China Youth Consumption Report" released by CCTV Finance show that the younger generation has great consumption potential, credit consumption has become an important way to upgrade consumption, 86.6% of young people are using credit products, nearly half of them have no debt accumulation, although the younger generation shows a rational consumption trend overall, which is very different from the "excessive spending" label attached by the outside world, but some young people do have excessive consumption and follow-up consumption behavior, and thus have too much financial pressure and debt risk, and even lead to gradual increase in social problems, financial enterprises should be brave in taking social responsibility and positive guidance.

src: 作为持牌消费金融机构，捷信一直致力于以优质、贴心的服务助力百姓构建自己的幸福生活，倡导消费者树立良好正确的消费观，并积极响应监管号召，以实际行动提升消费者尤其是年轻群体的理性消费意识。

chosen.text: As a licensed consumer finance institution, Home Credit has been committed to helping people build their own happy life with high-quality and considerate services, advocating that consumers establish good and correct consumption concepts, and actively responding to regulatory calls to enhance the rational consumption awareness of consumers, especially young people, with practical actions.

src: 在过去多年间，捷信不断针对包含大学生在内的青年群体开展全方位、多样化的金融知识普及活动，并通过与国内顶级院校合作发动创新实践大赛等多种形式潜移默化对年轻群体的消费需求进行合理引导,帮助其树立理性消费观念,合理规划消费需求,进而为其累积人生财富助力。

chosen.text: Over the past few years, China Credit Suisse has continuously carried out all-round and diverse financial knowledge popularization activities for young people including college students, and through cooperation with top domestic universities, it has launched various forms of innovation practice competitions to subtly guide the consumption needs of young people, help them establish rational consumption concepts, plan their consumption needs, and then help them accumulate wealth in life.

src: 双十二到来之际，捷信提醒所有消费者朋友树立合理的消费意识和正确的金钱观，抵制盲目消费和过度消费，规避消费借贷误区，以免影响个人征信以及今后的经济生活。

chosen.text: On the occasion of the 12.12 shopping festival, Home Credit reminds all consumers to establish a reasonable consumption awareness and a correct view of money, resist blind consumption and excessive consumption, and avoid the misunderstanding of consumer loans, so as not to affect personal credit and future economic life.

src: 消费时一定要提前规划，量力而为按时还款。

chosen.text: You must plan in advance when consuming, and repay on time according to your ability.

src: 如果逾期，逾期记录将记录到个人信用报告中，可能会对日后买车、购房等经济生活造成不良影响。

chosen.text: If overdue, the overdue record will be recorded in the personal credit report, which may have a bad impact on future car buying, house buying and other economic life.

src: 与此同时，在享受金融产品和服务时，还应选择正规机构及渠道，并注意查验相关机构是否具备经营资质。

chosen.text: At the same time, when enjoying financial products and services, it is also necessary to choose formal institutions and channels, and pay attention to check whether the relevant institutions have the qualifications to operate.

src: 未来，捷信将一如既往凭借其成熟、可靠的消费金融体系和不断更新迭代的金融产品，为消费者带来更贴合需求和多元化的服务，不断助力大众提升金融知识水平，帮助消费者培养理性消费、适度借贷的理念，做消费者终生可信赖的消费金融伙伴。

chosen.text: In the future, CITIC Consumer Finance will continue to leverage its mature and reliable consumer finance system and constantly update and iterate its financial products to provide consumers with more personalized and diversified services, continuously help the public improve their financial knowledge, help consumers cultivate the concept of rational consumption and moderate borrowing, and become a consumer’s lifelong trusted consumer finance partner.

chosen.text: People's Daily Online - The Gulf Cooperation Council should respond to common challenges

src: 沙特王储穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼的停留站包括阿曼、阿拉伯联合酋长国（阿联酋 ） 、 卡塔尔、巴林和科威特。

chosen.text: The stopovers of Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman include Oman, United Arab Emirates (UAE), Qatar, Bahrain and Kuwait.

src: 值得注意的是，这是自沙特阿拉伯及其阿拉伯盟友于 2017 年年中对卡塔尔实施禁运，导致海湾外交危机以来，穆罕默德王储首次访问卡塔尔。

chosen.text: It is worth noting that this is the first visit of Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman to Qatar since Saudi Arabia and its Arab allies imposed a blockade on Qatar in mid-2017, leading to a diplomatic crisis in the Gulf.

src: 在这场危机中，沙特阿拉伯、阿联酋、巴林和埃及断绝了与卡塔尔的外交关系，并对其实施全面禁运，指责卡塔尔支持恐怖组织，同时与伊朗有着密切关系。

chosen.text: In the crisis, Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Bahrain and Egypt have severed diplomatic ties with Qatar and imposed a comprehensive embargo on it, accusing it of supporting terrorist organizations and having close ties with Iran.

src: 外交紧张严重影响了海合会的内部团结，对该地区国家的经济产生了负面影响。

chosen.text: The diplomatic tensions have seriously affected the internal unity of the Gulf Cooperation Council and have had a negative impact on the economies of the countries in the region.

src: 四个阿拉伯国家封锁了通往卡塔尔的陆海空路线。

chosen.text: Four Arab countries have blocked land, sea and air routes to Qatar.

src: 这场危机仅在 2021 年 1 月的海湾合作委员会峰会上得到解决，各海湾国家签署了一项由美国和科威特调解迈向“团结与稳定”的协议。

chosen.text: The crisis was resolved only at the January 2021 Gulf Cooperation Council summit, where the Gulf states signed an agreement to move towards "unity and stability" mediated by the United States and Kuwait.

src: 沙特阿拉伯重新开放了与卡塔尔的边界。

chosen.text: Saudi Arabia has reopened its border with Qatar.

src: 沙特阿拉伯和埃及正在通过两国在卡塔尔任命了新大使率先努力恢复与卡塔尔的关系。

chosen.text: Saudi Arabia and Egypt are leading the effort to restore relations with Qatar, with the appointment of new ambassadors to the country.

src: 海湾阿拉伯国家化解分歧，以恢复与卡塔尔的关系出自于为各国的利益和地区稳定而必须团结起来的要求，旨在应对共同挑战。

chosen.text: The Gulf Arab countries resolve their differences to restore relations with Qatar, which is based on the requirement of uniting for the interests of all countries and regional stability, and aims to address common challenges.

src: 此次沙特王储访问阿曼期间，双方同意开通了两个海湾邻国间第一条直接陆路通道。

chosen.text: During the visit of the Saudi Arabian Crown Prince to Oman, the two sides agreed to open the first direct land route between the two Gulf neighbors.

src: 连接两国长达725公里长的通道将为两国公民的出行和整合供应链提供便利条件。

chosen.text: The 725-kilometer-long corridor connecting the two countries will provide convenience for the travel of citizens and integration of supply chain.

src: 沙特阿拉伯公共投资基金 (PIF)将在阿曼投入50亿美元，两国企业签署了价值为300亿美元的13份合作谅解备忘录。

chosen.text: The Public Investment Fund (PIF) of Saudi Arabia will invest $5 billion in Oman, and the two countries’ enterprises signed 13 memorandums of understanding worth $30 billion.

src: 沙特王储对海湾国家访问之行恰逢伊朗与世界各大国就挽救名为《联合全面行动计划 》 （ JCPOA）的伊朗核协议 — — 一项海湾阿拉伯国家因认为无法解决与伊朗导弹问题而谴责的协议进行谈判。

chosen.text: The visit of the Saudi Crown Prince to the Gulf countries coincided with the negotiations between Iran and major world powers to save the Iran nuclear agreement, known as the Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action (JCPOA), which the Arab Gulf countries condemned because they believed it could not resolve the missile issue with Iran.

src: 各海湾国家一直将伊朗视为长期的“竞争对手 ” ， 并将伊朗的核计划视为对地区安全的“威胁 ” 。

chosen.text: The Gulf countries have always regarded Iran as a long-term "competitor" and regarded Iran's nuclear program as a "threat" to regional security.

src: 各海湾国家认为，不解决伊朗导弹问题，不采取行动来遏制伊朗在该地区的活动是有缺陷的。

chosen.text: Against the backdrop that the major powers and Iran failed to meet the wishes of the Gulf countries in nuclear negotiations, Saudi Arabia and Iran have conducted direct negotiations.

src: 其目标是遏制该地区紧张局势的升级。

src: 这是海湾合作委员会重新评估为促进恢复海合会统一作出贡献的外交成果的机会，同时提出各项措施，使其成员国充分合作，以应对共同挑战，为海湾国家的稳定与发展作出贡献。

src: 让大学精神与时代精神同频共振-新华网

chosen.text: Let the university spirit resonate with the spirit of the times - Xinhuanet

src: 所谓大学精神，是指一所大学在发展过程中长期积淀形成的一系列办学理念和价值追求，是大学的灵魂所在。

chosen.text: The so-called university spirit refers to a series of educational concepts and values that have been accumulated over time during the development process of a university, which is the soul of the university.

src: 从古至今，大学精神对于政治、经济、文化、科技、社会的发展，乃至一个民族的进步均至关重要。

chosen.text: From ancient times to the present, the university spirit is crucial for the development of politics, economy, culture, science and technology, society, and even the progress of a nation.

src: 从世界第一所现代意义上的大学诞生起，大学就肩负起不同于其他社会组织的独特使命，对于我国大学来说，兴起于民族危难之秋，其精神更是深受传统文化和时代变迁的影响，倡导“明德济世，修齐治平”的价值理念和“兴学强国”的爱国主义担当。

chosen.text: Since the birth of the world's first modern university, universities have taken on a unique mission different from other social organizations. For our country's universities, which emerged in the autumn of national crisis, their spirit is deeply influenced by traditional culture and changes in the times, advocating the value concept of "moral integrity and helping the world, self-cultivation, family management, state governance, and peace" and the patriotic responsibility of "revitalizing education and strengthening the nation".

src: 当前，高等教育信息化、国际化趋势日益明显，全球范围的教育竞争、科技竞争、人才竞争不断加剧，高等教育事业作为重要的“供给侧 ” ， 其结构性改革正面临前所未有的机遇和挑战。

chosen.text: At present, the trend of higher education informatization and internationalization is becoming increasingly obvious. The global competition in education, science and technology, and talent is constantly intensifying. As an important "supply side", the structural reform of higher education is facing unprecedented opportunities and challenges.

src: 尤其是《统筹推进世界一流大学和一流学科建设总体方案》的提出，在展示了我国从高等教育大国向高等教育强国迈进的信心和决心的同时，更是对大学发展提出了更高更新的要求。

chosen.text: In particular, the proposal of the Overall Plan for Coordinating the Construction of World-class Universities and First-class Disciplines has demonstrated China's confidence and determination to move from a large country with higher education to a powerful country with higher education, and has also put forward higher and newer requirements for the development of universities.

src: 如何在较短时间内努力跻身世界一流行列，在仍有一定差距的基础上加快建成若干所世界一流大学和一批世界一流学科，实现“弯道超车 ” ？

chosen.text: How can we strive to rank among the world’s top universities in a relatively short time, accelerate the construction of several world-class universities and a number of world-class disciplines on the basis of still having certain gaps, and achieve “overtaking on a curve”?

src: 除了坚定目标自信、路径自信、能力自信，高校还应当充分发挥三种优势：一是后发优势，通过持续引进海外杰出学术人才，学习借鉴世界一流大学的先进经验，实现学术水平和办学质量的显著提升；二是文化优势，继承中华文明在五千年积淀的智慧内涵，弘扬发展优秀传统文化，以此来凝聚力量、塑造品牌、提升形象；三是制度优势，发挥社会主义国家的制度优越性，强化目标驱动，汇集共识合力，优化资源配置，为学校加速赶超世界先进水平提供可持续的坚实保障。

chosen.text: In addition to firm confidence in goals, paths and capabilities, universities should also give full play to three advantages: first, latecomer advantage, by continuously introducing outstanding overseas academic talents, learning from the advanced experience of world-class universities, and achieving a significant improvement in academic level and school-running quality; second, cultural advantage, inheriting the wisdom of Chinese civilization accumulated over five thousand years, carrying forward and developing excellent traditional culture, so as to gather strength, shape brands and enhance image; third, institutional advantage, giving play to the institutional superiority of socialist countries, strengthening goal-driven, pooling consensus and joint efforts, optimizing resource allocation, and providing sustainable and solid guarantee for schools to accelerate catching up with the world's advanced level.

src: 特别要意识到，建设世界一流大学不可能千校一面，各个学校在发挥优势的同时，必须彰显个性和特色。

chosen.text: It is particularly important to realize that it is impossible to build a world-class university in the same way. While playing to their strengths, each school must also show their individuality and characteristics.

src: 办学特色既要有共性的中国特色，也要体现各自独特的目标定位、办学传统和资源禀赋。

chosen.text: The characteristics of running schools should have common Chinese characteristics and also reflect their own unique goals, educational traditions and resource endowments.

src: 就浙江大学而言，我们在办学中注重突出三个方面的特色：一是突出创新创业人才培养特色，构建科教融合、校企结合的整合育人环境，形成全链条的创业教育生态系统；二是突出学科交叉会聚特色，推动学科体系的优化调整，营造学科交叉的制度环境，积极培育交叉新兴学科和标志性交叉成果；三是突出办学体系和社会服务特色，开展深度国际交流合作，加快形成泛浙大产学研合作体系。

chosen.text: For Zhejiang University, we focus on highlighting three aspects in our university management: first, we focus on highlighting the characteristics of talent training for innovation and entrepreneurship, build an integrated education environment combining science and education and industry and enterprise, and form a full-chain entrepreneurship education ecosystem; second, we focus on highlighting the characteristics of interdisciplinary convergence, promote the optimization and adjustment of the academic system, create an institutional environment for interdisciplinary convergence, and actively cultivate new interdisciplinary emerging disciplines and landmark interdisciplinary achievements; third, we focus on highlighting the characteristics of the university management system and social service, carry out in-depth international exchanges and cooperation, and accelerate the formation of a pan-Zhejiang University industry-university-research cooperation system.

src: 在这个过程中，尤为重要的是，要始终坚守大学精神，让大学精神与时代精神同频共振。

chosen.text: In this process, it is particularly important to always adhere to the university spirit and make the university spirit resonate with the spirit of the times.

src: 对于浙江大学来说 ， “ 求是创新”校训 ， “ 勤学、修德、明辨、笃实”共同价值观以及“海纳江河、启真厚德、开物前民、树我邦国”共同构成了浙大精神的最新表述体系。

chosen.text: For Zhejiang University, the school motto of "seeking truth and innovation", the common values of "studying hard, cultivating virtue, making a clear distinction, and being earnest", and "embracing rivers and lakes, enlightening truth and virtue, opening up things for the people, and building our country" together constitute the latest expression system of Zhejiang University spirit.

src: 这是学校坚持正确办学方向，不断积累文化高度、凝聚精神力量的重要保障，内涵丰富，意义深远。

chosen.text: This is an important guarantee for the school to adhere to the correct direction of running the school, constantly accumulate cultural heights and concentrate spiritual power. It is rich in connotation and has far-reaching significance.

src: 其中 ， “ 海纳江河”强调的是开放包容精神，体现以“天下英才为我所用”的胸怀，表现为汲取世界名校办学育人的优质理念 ； “ 启真厚德”强调的是求真至善精神，指的是大学在追求真理的同时，更当领受德行的陶冶和人格的砥砺 ； “ 开物前民”体现的是改革创新精神，既包含知识的求新，科研的创新，又表现为改革发展，革故鼎新 ； “ 树我邦国”强调的是爱国奉献精神，讲的是大学应当始终与民族命运同荣共辱。

chosen.text: Among them, "Haina River" emphasizes the spirit of openness and inclusiveness, reflects the mind of "using talents from all over the world", and is manifested as drawing on the high-quality concepts of running schools and educating people of world-famous universities; "Qizhen Houde" emphasizes the spirit of truth-seeking and goodness, which means that while pursuing truth, universities should also receive moral cultivation and personality; "Kaiwu Qianmin" reflects the spirit of reform and innovation, which includes the pursuit of knowledge, scientific research innovation, and is manifested as reform and development, and the overthrow of the old and the establishment of the new; "Shuwo Bangguo" emphasizes the spirit of patriotism and dedication, which means that universities should always be with the nation's destiny.

src: 这一系列精神理念和价值追求，正是浙江大学120年办学的灵魂所在。

chosen.text: These series of spiritual concepts and values are exactly the soul of Zhejiang University’s 120-year-old history.

src: “聪者听于无声，明者见于未形 ” 。

chosen.text: "The wise hear in silence and the wise see in the unformed."

src: 中国高校当进一步立足中国特色社会主义事业全局，深刻把握高等教育事业所处的时代方位和肩负的历史使命，加快建设成为世界一流大学。

chosen.text: Chinese universities should further base themselves on the overall situation of socialism with Chinese characteristics, deeply understand the era position and historical mission of higher education, and accelerate the construction of world-class universities.

src: 同时，坚守人文关怀和独立自由，让大学精神与时代精神、民族精神互相激荡，从而为实现国家富强和民族振兴，实现人类的共同理想提供不竭的动力。

chosen.text: At the same time, we should adhere to humanistic care and independence and freedom, and let the university spirit and the spirit of the times and the national spirit interact with each other, so as to provide endless motivation for the realization of national prosperity and national rejuvenation, and the realization of the common ideal of mankind.

src: 习近平指出，当今世界正经历百年未有之大变局，全球科技创新进入密集活跃期，新一轮科技革命和产业变革对全球经济结构产生了深刻影响。

src: 粤港澳大湾区要围绕建设国际科技创新中心战略定位，努力建设全球科技创新高地，推动新兴产业发展。

chosen.text: The Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area should focus on the strategic positioning of building an international science and technology innovation center, strive to build a global science and technology innovation highland, and promote the development of emerging industries.

src: 广西大学生休学创业年限最长可达５年-新华网

chosen.text: The longest period of time that university students in Guangxi can take a leave of absence to start a business is five years - Xinhuanet

src: 新华社南宁５月１９日专电（记者张莺）记者近日从广西壮族自治区教育厅获悉，今后广西各高校将实施弹性学制，放宽大学生休学年限，在校生休学创业的年限在原有学制基础上可延长２至５年，休学创业时间可视为实践教育时间。

chosen.text: Xinhua News Agency, Nanning, May 19 (Reporter Zhang Ying) The reporter learned from the Education Department of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region that in the future, Guangxi universities will implement flexible academic systems, relax the length of time for college students to take a break from school, and extend the length of time for students to take a break from school to start a business by 2 to 5 years on the basis of the original academic system. The time taken to take a break from school to start a business can be regarded as practical education time.

src: 为促进大学生创业创新能力提升，广西教育、人社等部门合力搭建创业平台，建设更多大学生校外实践教学基地、大学科技园、大学生创业园、创业孵化基地等，给大学生创业提供外在保障。

chosen.text: In order to promote the improvement of college students' entrepreneurship and innovation ability, Guangxi Education, Human Resources and Social Security and other departments have jointly built an entrepreneurial platform, built more off-campus practice teaching bases for college students, university science parks, college students' business parks, business incubation bases, etc., and provided external guarantees for college students' entrepreneurship.

src: 根据要求，到２０２０年，各高校创新创业实践基地面积，本科学校要达到３０００平方米以上，高职学校要达到２０００平方米以上。

chosen.text: According to the requirements, by 2020, the area of innovation and entrepreneurship practice base of each university should reach more than 30,000 square meters for undergraduate schools and more than 20,000 square meters for vocational schools.

src: 政府鼓励高校设立创新创业学分，优先支持在创新创业实践中表现优异的学生转专业。

chosen.text: The government encourages colleges and universities to establish innovation and entrepreneurship credits, and gives priority to supporting students who perform excellently in innovation and entrepreneurship practice to change their majors.

src: 高校教师每两年要至少有两个月到行业企业挂职锻炼，以此提高教师创新创业教育的意识和能力。

chosen.text: Teachers in colleges and universities should spend at least two months every two years to work in industry enterprises for job training, so as to improve their awareness and ability of entrepreneurship and innovation education.

src: 自治区教育厅要求广西各高校深入实施大学生创新创业训练计划，力争使每一名大学生在校期间都参与一项创新创业训练计划。

chosen.text: The Education Department of the autonomous region requires all colleges and universities in Guangxi to implement the innovation and entrepreneurship training plan for college students, and strive to make every college student participate in an innovation and entrepreneurship training plan during their school years.

src: 高校要积极组织学生参加各级各类创新创业竞赛，并给予经费支持。

chosen.text: Colleges and universities should actively organize students to participate in various innovation and entrepreneurship competitions at all levels, and provide financial support.

src: NEWS GOV-MO: 澳大向7位杰出人士颁授荣誉博士学位

chosen.text: NEWS GOV-MO: UM Honours Seven Distinguished Persons with Honorary Doctorates

src: 澳门大学今（11）日举行“2021年荣誉学位及高等学位颁授典礼 ＂ ， 向刘遵义、陈凯先、中村修二、李兰娟、李效良、朱丽兰及江朝晖颁授澳大荣誉博士学位，以表彰其卓越成就、为社会和教育的发展所作出的重大贡献。

chosen.text: The University of Macau (UM) held the "2021 Honorary Degree and Advanced Degree Award Ceremony" today (11), awarding honorary doctorates to Liu Zunyi, Chen Kaixian, Shuji Nakamura, Li Lanjuan, Li Xiaoliang, Zhu Lilan and Jiang Zhaohui in recognition of their outstanding achievements and significant contributions to the development of society and education.

src: 颁授典礼上，行政长官兼澳大校监代表、社会文化司司长欧阳瑜在澳大校董会主席林金城、澳大校长宋永华陪同下颁授荣誉博士学位。

chosen.text: At the award ceremony, Chief Executive and representative of the University of Macau Council, Secretary for Social Affairs and Culture Ouyang Yu presented honorary doctorate degrees in the presence of President of the University of Macau Council, Lin Jin Cheng, and President of the University of Macau, Song Yonghua.

src: 刘遵义教授获颁荣誉教育博士学位、陈凯先教授获颁荣誉理学博士学位、中村修二教授获颁荣誉理学博士学位、李兰娟教授获颁荣誉理学博士学位、李效良教授获颁荣誉工商管理博士学位、朱丽兰教授获颁荣誉理学博士学位，江朝晖女士获颁荣誉理学博士学位。

chosen.text: Professor Liu Zunyi was awarded an honorary Doctor of Education, Professor Chen Kaixian was awarded an honorary Doctor of Science, Professor Nakamura Shuji was awarded an honorary Doctor of Science, Professor Li Lanjuan was awarded an honorary Doctor of Science, Professor Li Xiaoliang was awarded an honorary Doctor of Business Administration, Professor Zhu Lilan was awarded an honorary Doctor of Science, and Ms. Jiang Zhaohui was awarded an honorary Doctor of Science.

src: 欧阳瑜致辞时首先向获颁发荣誉博士学位的七位杰出人士，表示热烈的祝贺并致以崇高的敬意，他们分别在不同的领域取得非凡的成就，为国家的发展和世界的进步作出了卓越的贡献；同时，欧阳瑜向毕业生和家长表达最真挚的祝福，也向大学爱岗敬业、学术精湛的教职员团队致以由衷的敬意。

chosen.text: When delivering his speech, Ouyang Yu first extended warm congratulations and high respect to the seven outstanding individuals who were awarded honorary doctorates, as they have achieved remarkable accomplishments in different fields and made outstanding contributions to the development of the country and the progress of the world; he also expressed his most sincere blessings to graduates and parents, and paid heartfelt respects to the university’s teaching staff team who are devoted to their jobs and have excellent academic skills.

src: 澳大人文学院讲座教授孙艺风宣读刘遵义赞辞时表示，刘遵义教授是一位享誉全球的经济学家，以其卓越的学术成就和前瞻性的教育理念而闻名。

chosen.text: Sun Yifeng, a chair professor of the Faculty of Humanities at the University of Macau, said in his eulogy for Professor Liu Zunyi that Professor Liu Zunyi is a globally renowned economist, known for his outstanding academic achievements and forward-looking educational concepts.

src: 除了在经济发展、经济增长及东亚经济领域取得的成就外，他还是一位富有远见的教育领导者。

chosen.text: In addition to his achievements in economic development, economic growth and East Asian economy, he was also a visionary educational leader.

src: 简而言之，他在众多领域都有杰出建树。

chosen.text: In short, he was an outstanding man in so many areas.

src: 孙艺风宣读中村修二赞辞时表示，中村修二教授是可持续能源技术的先驱者。

chosen.text: When reading the tribute to Shuji Nakamura, Sun Yifeng said that Professor Shuji Nakamura is a pioneer in sustainable energy technology.

src: 他因发明蓝色发光二极管（LED）而成为2014年诺贝尔物理学奖的三位获奖者之一。

chosen.text: He was one of three winners of the 2014 Nobel Prize in Physics for his invention of the blue light-emitting diode (LED).

src: 中村教授的发明不仅彻底改变了照明行业，更推动产生了如今广泛应用于日常生活和工业生产的白色发光二极管，为人类的福祉做出了巨大的贡献。

chosen.text: Professor Nakamura’s invention not only completely changed the lighting industry, but also promoted the production of white light-emitting diodes that are widely used in daily life and industrial production today, making a great contribution to human well-being.

src: 孙艺风宣读李兰娟赞辞时表示，李兰娟教授作为中国人工肝事业的开拓者，创建独特有效的李氏人工肝系统，治疗重型肝炎肝衰竭获重大突破，显著降低肝衰竭的病死率。

chosen.text: Sun Yifeng read out the praise for Li Lanjuan, saying that Professor Li Lanjuan, as a pioneer of artificial liver in China, created a unique and effective artificial liver system, made major breakthroughs in treating severe hepatitis and liver failure, and significantly reduced the mortality rate of liver failure.

src: 在这次新冠肺炎抗击战中，她和团队所提出的“四抗二平衡”方案及带去的人工肝、微生态和干细胞三大技术，显著提高了重症救治率。

chosen.text: In this battle against COVID-19, the "Four Resistances and Two Balances" plan proposed by her and her team, as well as the three technologies of artificial liver, microecology and stem cells, have significantly increased the treatment rate of severe cases.

src: 孙艺风宣读李效良赞辞时表示，李效良教授为运营管理的创新研究奠定了基础，塑造了供应链理论和实践的思维方式，并彻底改变了世界各地的商业模式。

chosen.text: When reading the praises of Li Xiaoliang, Sun Yifeng said that Professor Li Xiaoliang laid the foundation for innovative research in operations management, shaped the thinking mode of supply chain theory and practice, and completely changed the business model around the world.

src: 李效良因普及运筹管理中的长鞭效应概念而闻名，并探索了应对这种现象的措施。

chosen.text: Lee Hsueh-liang is known for popularizing the concept of the whip effect in operations management and exploring measures to counteract it.

src: 如今，各国在疫情及紧张的经济局势下，长鞭效应愈发突显，引发供应链严重破坏。

chosen.text: In the face of the epidemic and the tense economic situation, the long whip effect has become more prominent, leading to serious disruption of the supply chain.

src: 李效良具有远见的研究如雪中送炭，帮助行业应对困境，从而带来巨大的社会价值。

chosen.text: Li Xiaoliang’s far-sighted research is like a ray of hope in the snow, helping the industry to cope with difficulties, and thus bringing about great social value.

src: 孙艺风宣读朱丽兰赞辞时表示，在科研工作中，她发现了一种突破性和创新的染色技术用于制备样品，在国内外科技同行中享有较高声誉。

src: 比如如何增加顾客数（战术思维）之上，可以思考是在当前领域持续深化还是横向领域延展（战略思维）；比如提升顾客留存率（战术思维）之上，可以思考如何提升核心顾客和高价值顾客的留存率（战略思维）；在提升活动参与度（战术思维）之上，可以考虑如何设置正确的活动KPI，达到正确的活动目标，比如提升目标顾客参与度、激活高价值沉默客、精准拉新；在提升DAU（战术思维）之上，可以考虑目前的增长是否健康可持续。

chosen.text: For example, on top of how to increase the number of customers (tactical thinking), we can think about whether to continue to deepen in the current field or expand horizontally (strategic thinking); for example, on top of how to improve customer retention (tactical thinking), we can think about how to improve the retention rate of core customers and high-value customers (strategic thinking); on top of how to improve participation in activities (tactical thinking), we can consider how to set the correct activity KPI, achieve the correct activity goal, such as improving the participation of target customers, activating high-value silent customers, and precise new customers; on top of how to improve DAU (tactical thinking), we can consider whether the current growth is healthy and sustainable.

src: 美亚裔团体投诉耶鲁等3所常春藤名校招生歧视-新华网

chosen.text: Asian-American groups complain of Yale and other three Ivy League universities for discrimination in admissions - Xinhuanet

src: 新华社华盛顿５月２３日电（记者徐剑梅）美国１３０多个亚裔团体２３日向美国教育部和司法部提交申诉，抗议３所常春藤名校 — — 耶鲁大学、布朗大学和达特茅斯学院在招生过程中歧视亚裔申请学生。

chosen.text: Xinhua News Agency, Washington, May 23 (Reporter Xu Jianmei) More than 130 Asian-American groups filed a complaint with the U.S. Department of Education and the Justice Department on May 23, protesting against discrimination against Asian-American applicants in the enrollment process by three Ivy League universities - Yale University, Brown University and Dartmouth College.

src: 牵头发起申诉的亚裔教育联盟当天在华盛顿召开新闻发布会。

chosen.text: The Asian Education Coalition, which led the appeal, held a press conference in Washington on the same day.

src: 该团体主席赵宇空在发布会上说，过去１０年里，符合美国名校录取条件的亚裔申请人数量成倍增长，但在这３所美国名校中，亚裔所占比例基本维持在同一水平。

chosen.text: Zhao Yukong, the chairman of the group, said at the press conference that over the past 10 years, the number of Asian applicants who met the admission requirements of American universities has doubled, but the proportion of Asian students in these three American universities has remained at the same level.

src: 许多研究表明，这些高校在所谓“综合考量”的招生过程中 ， “ 长期持续性以及系统化地歧视亚裔申请学生 ” 。

chosen.text: Many studies have shown that these universities have "long-term continuity and systematic discrimination against Asian applicants" in the so-called "comprehensive consideration" of the admission process.

src: 赵宇空介绍说，２０１４年桑德斯等学者的研究显示，在这３所高校里，相对申请者人数，亚裔在所有族裔中录取率最低。

chosen.text: Zhao Yunkong said that in 2014, Sanders and other scholars’ research showed that among these three universities, Asian students had the lowest acceptance rate compared to the number of applicants in all ethnic groups.

src: 美国教育部的数据也显示，在所有常春藤盟校中，布朗大学和达特茅斯学院对亚裔学生的录取比例最低，耶鲁大学和布朗大学对亚裔申请学生实施了事实上的种族配额达２０年以上。

chosen.text: The data of the U.S. Department of Education also shows that among all Ivy League schools, Brown University and Dartmouth College have the lowest proportion of Asian students admitted, and Yale University and Brown University have implemented de facto racial quotas for Asian applicants for more than 20 years.

src: 赵宇空告诉新华社记者，他们期望提交申诉后，美国教育部、司法部能够展开调查，并在认定事实后采取措施阻止这些高校继续在招生中歧视亚裔。

chosen.text: Zhao Yukong told Xinhua News Agency that they expect the U.S. Department of Education and Justice to launch an investigation after submitting the appeal, and take measures to prevent these universities from continuing to discriminate against Asians in enrollment after finding out the facts.

src: 他们也期望被投诉高校能够主动重视这一问题，改变对亚裔的招生政策。

chosen.text: They also expect the universities to take the initiative to pay attention to this issue and change their admission policies for Asian students.

src: 目前，被投诉的３所高校尚未作出回应。

chosen.text: At present, the three universities that were complained about have not yet responded.

src: 亚裔教育联盟成立于２０１５年，当时曾投诉哈佛大学招生歧视，但美国教育部以程序理由未予受理。

chosen.text: The Asian American Coalition for Education was founded in 2015, and at that time, it complained about Harvard University's admission discrimination, but the US Department of Education did not accept it for procedural reasons.

src: 此次参与申诉的除美国华裔团体外，还包括美国印度裔、韩裔、日裔、巴基斯坦裔教育团体。

chosen.text: In addition to the Chinese-American groups, the Indian-American, Korean-American, Japanese-American and Pakistani-American education groups also participated in this appeal.

src: 2020年9月，陆先生从房屋中介了解到一处位于浙江余姚丈亭镇的厂房，在多次现场看房后，陆先生决定购买该厂房。

chosen.text: In September 2020, Mr. Lu learned from a real estate agent about a factory building in Zhangting Town, Yuyao, Zhejiang Province. After visiting the site several times, Mr. Lu decided to buy the factory building.

src: 同年12月，陆先生就购买厂房的细节与房屋所有权人的家属林某进行磋商后，于当天通过银行转账汇款20万元作定金。

chosen.text: In December of the same year, after Mr. Lu negotiated the details of the purchase of the factory with the family of the owner of the house, Mr. Lin, he paid 200,000 yuan as a deposit through bank transfer on the same day.

src: 林某在《厂房买卖定金收条》上作为收款人签名，其中载明，“若买方不想买此厂房，此定金归卖家，如卖方不愿意卖此厂房，定金将双倍返还卖方，双方约定一周内签订厂房买卖合同。”

chosen.text: Lin signed as the payee on the "Factory Building Purchase Deposit Receipt", which stated, "If the buyer does not want to buy this factory building, the deposit will be returned to the seller, and if the seller does not want to sell this factory building, the deposit will be doubled and returned to the seller, and both parties agreed to sign a factory building sales contract within one week."

src: 然而，之后双方因厂房出售范围、付款方式等主要合同条款未能形成一致意见，导致房屋买卖合同迟迟未能签订。

chosen.text: However, the two parties failed to reach a consensus on the main contract terms such as the scope of the sale of the factory building and the payment method, which led to the delay in signing the house sales contract.

src: 考虑到双方未能就合同内容达成共识，几天后，林某将20万元定金退回给了陆先生。

chosen.text: Considering that the two parties failed to reach a consensus on the contract content, Lin returned the 200,000 yuan deposit to Mr. Lu a few days later.

src: 好不容易看中的房子，定金交了，房款也准备好了，就差“临门一脚”签合同，卖方却不卖了，这让陆先生无奈又愤怒。

chosen.text: After a lot of effort, Mr. Lu found a house he liked, paid the deposit, and prepared the house payment. All he needed was to sign the contract, but the seller refused to sell. This made Mr. Lu helpless and angry.

src: 为此，陆先生将林某起诉至余姚市人民法院。

chosen.text: For this reason, Mr. Lu sued Mr. Lin to the People's Court of Yuyao City.

src: 法院经审理认为，双方最终未能签订正式合同，不能仅归责于被告，应合理推定为磋商不成，故本案不应适用定金罚则，被告无需承担双倍返还定金的违约责任。

chosen.text: The court held that the failure of the two parties to sign a formal contract should not be attributed solely to the defendant, and it should be reasonably presumed that the negotiation failed. Therefore, the deposit penalty rule should not be applied in this case, and the defendant did not need to bear the liability for breach of contract of double return of the deposit.

src: 一审判决后，原告提起上诉。

chosen.text: After the first instance judgment, the plaintiff appealed.

src: 近日，二审法院维持原判。

chosen.text: Recently, the second-instance court upheld the original judgment.

src: 【律师提醒】 在交易过程中要尽到必要的审慎注意义务。

chosen.text: [Lawyer's Reminder] You should fulfill the necessary duty of care during the transaction process.

src: 在签订合同时，作为买方要尽到必要的审慎注意义务，比如，核实房屋所有权人信息、房屋是否被人占用等相关信息，并在合同中明确关于交付的具体时间、地点，以防履行合同时双方产生争议。

chosen.text: When signing a contract, as a buyer, you should fulfill the necessary duty of care, such as verifying the information of the owner of the house, whether the house is occupied and other relevant information, and clearly define the specific time and place of delivery in the contract to prevent disputes between the two parties when performing the contract.

src: （德国之声中文网 ） " 民主峰会"周五结束后，中国外交部发言人周六（12月11日）发表谈话表示，美国举办"领导人民主峰会 " ， 是"以意识形态划线，把民主工具化、武器化，假民主之名行反民主之实，煽动分裂对抗，转移国内矛盾 " 。

chosen.text: (Sinica Deutsche Welle) After the "Democracy Summit" ended on Friday, a spokesman for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of China said in a statement on Saturday (December 11) that the United States held the "Leadership Summit for Democracy", which was "to draw ideological lines, to instrumentalize and weaponize democracy, to act against democracy in the name of democracy, to incite division and confrontation, and to divert domestic contradictions".

src: 中国政府认为 ， " 长期以来，美国将自己的政治制度和价值理念强加于人，推行'民主改造 ' ， 滥施单边制裁，策动'颜色革命 ' ， 造成灾难性后果。

chosen.text: The Chinese government believes that "for a long time, the United States has imposed its political system and values on others, carried out 'democratic transformation', imposed unilateral sanctions, instigated 'color revolutions', and caused disastrous consequences.

src: '民主'早已成为美国干涉别国的'大规模杀伤性武器 ' 。

chosen.text: This summit is an action for Biden to fulfill his campaign promises.

src: 为期两天的会议以视频方式进行，全球111个国家领导人应邀与会，其中包括台湾领导人，但中国和俄罗斯没有受到邀请。

chosen.text: The two-day meeting was held via video, and leaders of 111 countries around the world were invited to attend, including the leaders of Taiwan, but China and Russia were not invited.

src: 峰会前夕，中国和俄罗斯就以美国自身民主出现问题抨击美国，称美国没有资格主持召开这样的峰会。

chosen.text: On the eve of the summit, China and Russia criticized the United States for its own democratic problems, saying that the United States was not qualified to host such a summit.

src: 而国际上和美国国内也有质疑声音，例如批评受邀与会的包括一些有威权专制倾向的领导人，比如菲律宾、波兰和巴西等国的领导人，有人怀疑拜登政府的真正意图并非为了民主而是为了地缘政治目的组织了这次峰会。

chosen.text: There are also voices of doubt in the international community and within the United States, such as criticism that some leaders with authoritarian tendencies were invited to attend, such as leaders from the Philippines, Poland and Brazil. Some people suspect that the real intention of the Biden administration is not to organize this summit for democracy but for geopolitical purposes.

src: 刚上任的德国总理肖尔茨也参加了视频民主峰会
