src: 中国外交部周六的声明称 ， " 今天的美式民主病态尽显，金钱政治、身份政治、政党对立、政治极化、社会撕裂、种族矛盾、贫富分化等问题愈演愈烈 " ， 美国的民主是建立在资本基础上的"富人游戏 " 。

chosen.text: The statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs on Saturday said that "the American democracy is sickly today, and the problems such as money politics, identity politics, party opposition, political polarization, social division, racial contradictions, and income inequality have become more serious", and the American democracy is based on capital and is a "rich man's game".

src: 美国总统拜登在发言中表示 ， " 作为政府的领导人，我们有责任倾听我们的公民，加固民主的护栏，推动改革，实现透明的问责治理，更能抵御专制的缓冲和冲击的力量，以及那些想在公共利益之前赤裸裸地追求权力的人 。 "

chosen.text: U.S. President Biden said in his speech, "As leaders of government, we have a responsibility to listen to our citizens, strengthen the guardrails of democracy, promote reform, achieve transparent accountability governance, and be more resistant to the buffer and shock force of autocracy, as well as those who want to pursue power nakedly before the public interest. "

src: 他强调，民主并不是想当然的 ， " 我们必须在每一代人当中不断更新它，在我看来，这是我们这个时代的决定性挑战 。 "

chosen.text: He stressed that democracy is not taken for granted, "we must constantly renew it in every generation, and in my opinion, this is the decisive challenge of our time. "

src: 拜登还说，全球民主及人权"面对持续且令人忧心的挑战之际，民主需要斗士来捍卫 " 。

chosen.text: Biden also said that democracy and human rights around the world "face ongoing and worrying challenges," and that "democracy needs fighters to defend it."

src: 美国方面承诺，在本次民主峰会后，将展开为期一年的行动，包含一项金额4.244亿美元的倡议，以加强世界各地的民主，并对独立新闻媒体提供支持。

chosen.text: The United States has promised to launch a year-long campaign after this democracy summit, including a $424.4 million initiative to strengthen democracy around the world and support independent media.

src: 美国希望各国在计划于2022年底举行的实体民主峰会前，作出具体的公开承诺，以改善其民主制度。

src: 教育思考：大学考试如何让“学霸 ” “ 学渣”各得其所-新华网

chosen.text: Educational Thoughts: How Can University Examinations Help "Top Students" and "Poor Students" Find Their Places - Xinhuanet

src: 兰州交通大学3名学生给校领导写信，反映对大学考试的困惑，并提出提高考试难度，变换考试题型，让考试真正体现学生实际水平的诉求。

chosen.text: Three students from Lanzhou Jiaotong University wrote a letter to the school leaders, reflecting their confusion about the university exams and asking for an increase in the difficulty of the exams, changing the types of questions, and making the exams truly reflect the actual level of students.

src: 的确，长期以来，大学考试都是一个“热门话题 ” 。

chosen.text: Indeed, for a long time, university exams have been a “hot topic”.

src: 在大学校园，学生来自五湖四海，能力水平各不相同，再加之学习程度不一，学习的情况千差万别。

chosen.text: In a university campus, students come from all over the world, with different levels of ability, and with varying degrees of study, so the learning situation is very different.

src: 对于具有如此多元特征的群体进行考核，存在不同感受，在所难免。

chosen.text: It is inevitable that there are different feelings about assessing a group with such diverse characteristics.

src: 当然，如果考试试题题型单一、重复率高，题目过于简单，必然会造成另一种截然不同的感受。

chosen.text: Of course, if the exam questions are of a single type, with high repetition rates and too simple, it will inevitably cause a very different feeling.

src: 不用功的学生，可能考前集中突击就能及格，如若再想其他办法，有可能达到事半功倍的效果。

chosen.text: Students who do not work hard may be able to pass the exam by cramming before the exam. If they try other methods, it is possible that they will achieve twice the result with half the effort.

src: 如此一来，就出现“学渣”平时不投入也能过关、甚至得了高分 ； “ 学霸”平时从不落课，作业、笔记样样好，考试也没高出多少的“怪现状 ” 。

chosen.text: In this way, there will be "dull students" who can pass without putting in much effort and even get high scores; and "top students" who never miss classes, have good homework and notes, but do not score much higher on exams.

src: 这样看来，兰州交大的学生反映大学考试中存在的问题并非毫无来由，相信这种状况也不只兰州交大存在。

chosen.text: It seems that the students of Lanzhou Jiaotong University reflect on the problems existing in university examinations are not without reason, and it is believed that such conditions do not exist only at Lanzhou Jiaotong University.

src: 从这层意义上讲，要为这3名写信直陈的学生点赞。

chosen.text: In this sense, we should give a thumbs up to these three students who wrote a letter.

src: 其实，上过大学的人都清楚，突击备考、想各种办法从老师处“套取”考题，争取划考试范围，求得考前得到“重点辅导”的现象并不少见，甚至在考试中夹带小抄、考后求老师高抬贵手的情况也不是奇闻。

chosen.text: In fact, those who have attended university know that cramming for exams, trying various ways to “get” exam questions from teachers, striving to draw the scope of the exam, and seeking “key guidance” before the exam are not uncommon, and even bringing in cheat sheets during the exam and asking teachers to be lenient after the exam are not strange.

src: 在笔者看来，作为一种教学质量评估导向，衡量一所大学考试的合格与否，更在于教师对教与学的全面把握，以及在此基础上的科学命题。

chosen.text: In my view, as an orientation for teaching quality assessment, whether a university examination is qualified or not should be measured in terms of teachers’ comprehensive grasp of teaching and learning, as well as scientific questions based on this.

src: 进入大学本科阶段，专业开始细分，很多专业课程以基础知识为主。

chosen.text: In the undergraduate stage, the majors begin to be subdivided, and many professional courses are based on basic knowledge.

src: 毋庸置疑，是否全面掌握一个学科的基本知识点，是大学考试要考察的内容。

chosen.text: It is beyond doubt that whether to fully master the basic knowledge points of a subject is what university examinations will test.

src: 而本科知识基本都是学科基础理论和基本常识，从知识点而言，变化的空间并不大，基本是固定的。

chosen.text: Undergraduate knowledge is basically based on basic theories and common sense of disciplines. From the perspective of knowledge points, there is not much change, which is basically fixed.

src: 就像有教师所言 ， “ 20年前学大学数学的基本知识，现在还在学，还是重点 。 ”

chosen.text: As a teacher said, "The basic knowledge of college mathematics learned 20 years ago is still being studied now, and it is still the key point. "

src: 但知识点基本不变，并不代表考试题型单一、试题重复。

chosen.text: However, the knowledge points are basically unchanged, which does not mean that the types of exams are single and the questions are repeated.

src: 在很多大学，考试一般都会组成出题组，再由学科资深教师统筹组成试卷，考试阅卷也由承担该科的全体老师参与，这样就能在一定程度上克服试题重复的情况。

chosen.text: In many universities, the examination is generally composed of a question group, and then the senior teachers of the subject will make up the test paper. The marking of the examination will also be participated by all teachers who are responsible for the subject, so that the repetition of the test questions can be overcome to a certain extent.

src: 但要拟出一套符合教与学实际的试题，题目根据学生学习整体情况，难易呈正态分布，还需综合掌握教学情况，全面分析学生学习的程度，从而使考试命题对难易、题型有动态把握，既能突出基础知识考察，又能兼顾能力考查，同时对题型进行创新设计。

chosen.text: However, to draw up a set of test questions that are in line with the actual situation of teaching and learning, the questions should be based on the overall situation of students' learning, and the difficulty should be normally distributed. It is also necessary to comprehensively master the teaching situation and comprehensively analyze the degree of students' learning, so that the examination proposition has dynamic control over the difficulty and question types, which can not only highlight the basic knowledge inspection, but also take into account the ability inspection, and at the same time innovate the question types.

src: 考试是大学教育的指挥棒，有什么样的考试，学生就会有相应的备考方案，长此以往，将影响大学教育的成效。

chosen.text: Examinations are the baton of university education. Whatever kind of examinations there are, students will have corresponding preparation plans. In the long run, this will affect the effectiveness of university education.

src: 对于学生的建议信，兰州交大校方高度重视，已在全校部署了整改的方案。

chosen.text: Lanzhou Jiaotong University has attached great importance to the letter of advice from students and has deployed a rectification plan throughout the university.

src: 要求各教学单位组织教师开展研讨和课程结课考试对照自查，制定考试试卷命题及相关制度，同时加强对考试试卷命题及审核环节的监督与检查，细化成绩评定，加强课程教学各环节的全面考核。

chosen.text: It is required that each teaching unit organize teachers to carry out seminars and self-examination of course final examination, formulate examination papers, related systems, and strengthen supervision and inspection of the examination paper formulation and review process, refine the assessment, and strengthen the comprehensive assessment of all links in the course teaching.

src: 从机制上解决试题类型单一、题目重复等问题是大学考务需要面对的议题，当然需要出台相应的制度，但功夫贵在日常，需要教师对教学情况的全面掌握，不单要吃透教学内容，更须吃透学生学习情况，两头吃透，教与学将更好对接，形成良性互动，考试也将更加符合实际，从而让“学霸”和“学渣”各得其所。

chosen.text: Mechanically solving problems such as single question types and repeated questions is an issue that university examination affairs need to face. Of course, corresponding systems should be introduced, but the key lies in daily efforts. Teachers need to have a comprehensive grasp of teaching situations. They should not only thoroughly understand the teaching content, but also thoroughly understand the students' learning situation. With thorough understanding of both sides, teaching and learning will be better connected, forming a positive interaction, and the examination will be more in line with reality, so that "top students" and "poor students" can get what they deserve.

src: 沙巴3200名新生婴儿无报生纸 因特制防伪纸断货

chosen.text: Sabah 3,200 newborns without birth certificates due to shortage of special anti-counterfeiting paper

src: （亚庇11日讯）沙巴国民登记局说，由于特制防伪纸存货用光，所以自10月初开始就无法颁发报生纸给初生婴儿，至今累积的受影响者达3200人。

chosen.text: (Kota Kinabalu, 11th) Sabah National Registration Department said that since the supply of special anti-counterfeiting paper was exhausted, it has been unable to issue birth certificates to newborns since early October, and the number of affected people has reached 3,200.

src: 不过，该局主任凯鲁阿米努斯保证，所有已经申请报生纸的婴儿，资料已经记录在系统，当防伪纸在下周运到后就会补发。

chosen.text: However, the director of the Bureau, Kalu Amunus, assured that all babies who have applied for birth certificates have been recorded in the system and will be issued when the anti-counterfeiting paper arrives next week.

src: 他在新闻发布会上，针对一家网媒指沙巴报生纸印制问题出现长达10个月的报导，作出解释。

chosen.text: He made an explanation at the press conference against a web media's report that the printing problem of Sabah Birth Certificate had lasted for 10 months.

src: 他说，有关问题在2个月前就出现，砂拉越也面对同样的问题。

chosen.text: He said that the problem had appeared two months ago and Sarawak also faced the same problem.

src: “其中一个原因是生产特制防伪纸的中国厂家受疫情影响，导致延迟运抵我国 。 ”

chosen.text: "One of the reasons is that the Chinese manufacturers of special anti-counterfeiting paper were affected by the epidemic, resulting in the delay of delivery to our country. "

src: 他解释，沙巴报生纸使用的防伪纸和其他地区不同，因此不能商借其他州属的存货。

chosen.text: He explained that the anti-counterfeiting paper used in Sabah's birth certificate was different from other regions, so it could not be borrowed from other states.

src: 凯鲁阿米努斯透露，最新一批防伪纸已经于本月6日运抵吉隆坡，过后于8日交给印刷公司，进行部分印制工作。

chosen.text: Kaluaminus revealed that the latest batch of anti-counterfeiting paper had arrived in Kuala Lumpur on the 6th of this month, and was handed over to the printing company on the 8th for partial printing.

src: “该局下周四将派人到吉隆坡取货，回到沙巴立刻进行最后阶段的打印，估计多2个工作日（12月20日）就可以交到申请者手上 。 ”

chosen.text: "The Bureau will send people to Kuala Lumpur to pick up the goods next Thursday, and will immediately return to Sabah to carry out the final stage of printing. It is estimated that it will take another two working days (December 20) to be delivered to the applicants. "

src: “我们会通知申请者前往各地分局领取报生纸 。 ”

chosen.text: "We will notify the applicants to go to the local branches to pick up the birth certificates. "

src: 他补充，沙巴今年至今共发出2万4801张报生纸。

chosen.text: He added that Sabah has issued a total of 24,801 birth certificates so far this year.

src: 新华社北京12月11日电 人民日报12月12日评论员文章 ： “ 十四五”实现良好开局 — — 论学习贯彻中央经济工作会议精神

chosen.text: Xinhua News Agency, Beijing, December 11 -- People's Daily, December 12 -- Commentator's article: "14th Five-Year Plan" achieves a good start -- On studying and implementing the spirit of the Central Economic Work Conference

src: “实现了‘十四五’良好开局 ” ， 12月8日至10日举行的中央经济工作会议高度评价一年来我国经济社会发展取得的成绩。

chosen.text: "Realize a good start of the 14th Five-Year Plan", the Central Economic Work Conference held from December 8 to 10 highly appraised the achievements made by China's economic and social development over the past year.

src: 习近平总书记在会上发表重要讲话，深刻总结2021年经济工作，深入分析当前经济形势，对2022年经济工作作出重大部署，为我们做好明年经济工作，迎接党的二十大胜利召开，指明了前进方向、提供了根本遵循。

chosen.text: General Secretary Xi Jinping delivered an important speech at the meeting, profoundly summarized the economic work in 2021, analyzed the current economic situation in depth, and made major arrangements for the economic work in 2022, which pointed out the direction of progress and provided fundamental guidance for us to do a good job in next year's economic work and welcome the successful convening of the 20th National Congress of the Communist Party of China.

src: 我们隆重庆祝中国共产党成立一百周年，正式宣布全面建成小康社会、实现第一个百年奋斗目标，开启全面建设社会主义现代化国家、向第二个百年奋斗目标进军新征程。

chosen.text: We solemnly celebrate the 100th anniversary of the founding of the Communist Party of China, officially announce the completion of building a moderately prosperous society in all respects and achieving the first centenary goal, and embark on a new journey to comprehensively build a modern socialist country and achieve the second centenary goal.

src: 我们召开党的十九届六中全会，总结党的百年奋斗重大成就和历史经验，通过百年党史上第三个历史决议《中共中央关于党的百年奋斗重大成就和历史经验的决议 》 ， 这是新时代中国共产党人牢记初心使命、坚持和发展中国特色社会主义的政治宣言，是以史为鉴、开创未来、实现中华民族伟大复兴的行动指南。

chosen.text: We convened the Sixth Plenary Session of the 19th CPC Central Committee to summarize the major achievements and historical experience of the Party’s century-long struggle, and adopted the third historical resolution on the major achievements and historical experience of the Party’s century-long struggle, namely, the Resolution of the CPC Central Committee on Major Achievements and Historical Experience of the Party’s Century-Long Struggle, which is a political declaration for the new era of Chinese Communists to remember their original aspiration and mission, adhere to and develop socialism with Chinese characteristics, and a guide for us to learn from history, create a better future, and achieve the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation.

src: 一年来，世界百年未有之大变局和新冠肺炎疫情全球大流行交织影响，外部环境更趋复杂严峻，国内新冠肺炎疫情防控和经济社会发展各项任务极为繁重艰巨。

chosen.text: Over the past year, the world has been undergoing unprecedented changes and the global pandemic of COVID-19 have intertwined to affect each other, making the external environment more complex and severe. The tasks of epidemic prevention and control and economic and social development in China are extremely heavy and arduous.

src: 以习近平同志为核心的党中央坚持统筹国内国际两个大局，坚持稳中求进工作总基调，沉着应对百年变局和世纪疫情，统筹疫情防控和经济社会发展，加快构建新发展格局，强化宏观政策跨周期调节，着力促进经济持续健康发展，着力深化改革开放创新，奋力完成改革发展艰巨任务，党和国家各项事业取得了新的重大成就。

chosen.text: The Party Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping as the core has adhered to the overall planning of domestic and international situations, the general keynote of seeking progress while maintaining stability, calmly responded to the changes in the past century and the pandemic in the 21st century, coordinated epidemic prevention and control with economic and social development, accelerated the construction of a new development pattern, strengthened the cross-cycle adjustment of macro policies, focused on promoting sustainable and healthy economic development, focused on deepening reform, opening up and innovation, and strived to complete the arduous tasks of reform and development, and achieved new major achievements in all undertakings of the Party and the country.

src: “十四五”实现良好开局，一个重要方面体现在，构建新发展格局迈出新步伐，高质量发展取得新成效。

chosen.text: The good start of the "14th Five-Year Plan" is reflected in the following important aspect: the new development pattern has taken new steps, and high-quality development has achieved new results.

src: 我国经济发展和疫情防控保持全球领先地位，发展韧性强、潜力大、动力足的特点持续显现；国家战略科技力量加快壮大，重大创新成果竞相涌现，科技创新能力持续提升，关键核心技术攻关实现新突破；产业链韧性得到提升，对外贸易量增质升，结构继续优化，以新产业新业态新模式为代表的新动能成长壮大；改革开放向纵深推进，着力打通制约供需适配和要素流动的堵点，以高水平对外开放打造合作竞争新优势；民生保障有力有效，就业规模持续扩大，居民收入增长与经济增长基本同步，全年粮食连续7年保持在1.3万亿斤以上，喜获“十八连丰 ” ； 生态文明建设持续推进，碳达峰碳中和工作统筹推进，绿色低碳转型步伐稳健，生态环境保护取得新成效。

chosen.text: China’s economic development and epidemic prevention and control have maintained a leading position in the world, with strong resilience, great potential and sufficient momentum; national strategic scientific and technological forces have been rapidly strengthened, major innovation achievements have emerged, scientific and technological innovation capabilities have been continuously enhanced, and key core technologies have achieved new breakthroughs; the resilience of the industrial chain has been enhanced, foreign trade volume has increased and quality has improved, the structure has continued to be optimized, and new kinetic energy represented by new industries, new formats and new models has grown and expanded; reform and opening up have been advanced in depth, efforts have been made to remove the blockages that restrict supply and demand adaptation and factor flow, and new advantages in cooperation and competition have been created through high-level opening up; people’s livelihoods have been effectively guaranteed, employment scale has continued to expand, residents’ income growth has been basically synchronized with economic growth, grain production has remained above 1.3 trillion catties for seven consecutive years, and China has achieved “eighteen consecutive harvests”; ecological civilization construction has been continuously promoted, carbon peak and carbon neutrality work has been coordinated, green and low-carbon transformation has been steady, and new achievements have been made in ecological environment protection.

src: 这些成绩的取得，是以习近平同志为核心的党中央坚强领导的结果，是习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想科学指引的结果，是全党全国各族人民勠力同心、艰苦奋斗的结果。

chosen.text: These achievements are the result of the strong leadership of the Party Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping as the core, the result of the scientific guidance of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, and the result of the concerted efforts and hard work of the whole Party and people of all ethnic groups in the country.

src: 实践再次证明，党确立习近平同志党中央的核心、全党的核心地位，确立习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想的指导地位，对新时代党和国家事业发展、对推进中华民族伟大复兴历史进程具有决定性意义。

chosen.text: Practice has once again proved that the Party's establishment of Comrade Xi Jinping as the core of the Party Central Committee and the whole Party, and the establishment of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era as the guiding ideology, is of decisive significance to the development of the cause of the Party and the country in the new era and to the historical process of promoting the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation.

src: 有习近平总书记作为党中央的核心、全党的核心领航掌舵，有习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想科学指引，有全党全国各族人民团结一心、顽强奋斗，我们就一定能够战胜各种艰难险阻，在全面建设社会主义现代化国家新征程上创造新的时代辉煌、铸就新的历史伟业。

chosen.text: With General Secretary Xi Jinping as the core of the Party Central Committee and the whole Party, with the scientific guidance of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, and with the unity and tenacious struggle of the whole Party and people of all ethnic groups in the country, we will surely be able to overcome all kinds of difficulties and obstacles, and create new glories of the times and build new historical achievements on the new journey of building a modern socialist country in an all-round way.

src: 明年将召开党的二十大，这是党和国家政治生活中的一件大事。

chosen.text: The 20th National Congress of the Communist Party of China will be held next year, which is a major event in the political life of the Party and the country.

src: 弘扬伟大建党精神，坚持稳中求进工作总基调，完整、准确、全面贯彻新发展理念，加快构建新发展格局，全面深化改革开放，坚持创新驱动发展，推动高质量发展，坚持以供给侧结构性改革为主线，统筹疫情防控和经济社会发展，统筹发展和安全，继续做好“六稳 ” 、 “六保”工作，持续改善民生，着力稳定宏观经济大盘，保持经济运行在合理区间，保持社会大局稳定，我们就一定能保持平稳健康的经济环境、国泰民安的社会环境、风清气正的政治环境，以优异成绩迎接党的二十大胜利召开。

chosen.text: We should carry forward the great spirit of building the Party, adhere to the general keynote of seeking progress while maintaining stability, implement the new development concept in a complete, accurate and comprehensive manner, accelerate the construction of a new development pattern, comprehensively deepen reform and opening up, adhere to innovation-driven development, promote high-quality development, adhere to supply-side structural reform as the main line, coordinate epidemic prevention and control with economic and social development, coordinate development and security, continue to do a good job in "six stabilities" and "six guarantees", continuously improve people's livelihoods, focus on stabilizing the macro economy, keep the economy operating within a reasonable range, and maintain social stability. Then we will surely be able to maintain a stable and healthy economic environment, a peaceful and prosperous social environment, and a clean and upright political environment, and welcome the successful convening of the 20th National Congress of the Communist Party of China with excellent achievements.

src: 让我们更加紧密地团结在以习近平同志为核心的党中央周围，增强“四个意识 ” 、 坚定“四个自信 ” 、 做到“两个维护 ” ， 不断提高政治判断力、政治领悟力、政治执行力，以实际行动把党中央决策部署落实到位，不断把新时代中国特色社会主义事业推向前进。

chosen.text: Let us unite more closely around the Party Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping as the core, enhance the "Four Consciousnesses", strengthen the "Four Spheres of Confidence", and achieve the "Two Upholds", continuously improve political judgment, political comprehension, and political execution, implement the decisions and arrangements of the Party Central Committee in actual actions, and continue to push forward the cause of socialism with Chinese characteristics in the new era.

src: 教育资讯：北京压缩2016年初中入学特长生比例-新华网

chosen.text: Education news: Beijing compresses the proportion of specialized students in junior high school in 2016 - Xinhuanet

src: 21日、22日两日，北京市初中入学特长生考查工作由各区教委统一组织实施。

chosen.text: On the 21st and 22nd, the examination for special talents of junior high school students in Beijing was organized and implemented by the Education Committee of each district.

src: 今年，北京各区均压缩了特长生招生比例，特长生竞争更为激烈。

chosen.text: This year, all districts in Beijing have reduced the proportion of students with special talents, and the competition for students with special talents has become more intense.

src: 以东城区为例，今年该区小学升初中特长生入学比例总体不超过全区招生计划数的5 % ， 计划招生人数为380人，到校比例不超过学校招生计划数的10 % 。

chosen.text: For example, in Dongcheng District, this year, the proportion of elementary school students entering junior high schools with special skills is generally not more than 5% of the total number of admissions in the district, and the planned number of admissions is 380, but the proportion of students who actually attend school does not exceed 10% of the total number of admissions in the school.

src: 凡具有体育、艺术、科技特长且在网上报名的学生均有资格参加特长生招生考查。

chosen.text: Students with sports, art, and science and technology specialties who registered online are eligible to participate in the special talent enrollment examination.

src: 为方便学生就近参加考查，东城区延续去年的考查安排方式，在每个学区分别设置1~2个考查地点，共13个考查地点。

chosen.text: In order to facilitate students to take the examination nearby, Dongcheng District continued last year's arrangement of the examination, and set up 1-2 examination sites in each school district, a total of 13 examination sites.

chosen.text: Xinhua News Agency, Sarajevo, December 11 -- The president of the Olympic Committee of Bosnia and Herzegovina, Kvesic, said recently that Bosnia and Herzegovina is very much looking forward to the Beijing Winter Olympics and firmly believes that China has the ability to host the Winter Olympics in a special period.

src: 日前中国驻波黑大使季平在萨拉热窝奥林匹克中心会见波黑奥委会主席克韦西奇。

src: 会见时，克韦西奇积极评价波中关系并表示，他曾于2008年北京夏奥会之际访华，对中方出色的组织工作印象极为深刻，坚信中国有能力在特殊时期办好冬奥盛会；波方十分期待北京冬奥会，波黑奥委会正在积极组织参会；波方希望以此为契机，同中方在体育领域开展更为广泛的交流合作。

chosen.text: During the meeting, Kvesic spoke highly of China-Croatia relations and said that he had visited China on the occasion of the 2008 Beijing Summer Olympics and was deeply impressed by the excellent organization work of China. He firmly believed that China has the ability to host the Winter Olympic Games in a special period; Croatia is very much looking forward to the Beijing Winter Olympics, and the BiH Olympic Committee is actively organizing participation; Croatia hopes to take this as an opportunity to carry out more extensive exchanges and cooperation with China in the field of sports.

src: 48小时核酸阴性、设“缓冲区 ” 国务院联防联控机制发文要求加强口岸城市疫情防控-新华网

chosen.text: 48 hours of negative nucleic acid, set up a "buffer zone", the State Council joint prevention and control mechanism issued a document to strengthen the epidemic prevention and control in port cities - Xinhuanet

src: 新华社北京12月11日电（记者董瑞丰、顾天成）国务院联防联控机制日前印发关于加强口岸城市新冠肺炎疫情防控工作的通知，要求近期离开陆地边境口岸城市（与香港、澳门有口岸相连的除外）人员需持有48小时内核酸检测阴性证明，前往陆地边境口岸城市人员抵达后至少进行1次核酸检测。

chosen.text: Xinhua News Agency, Beijing, December 11 (Reporters Dong Ruifeng and Gu Tiancheng) The Joint Prevention and Control Mechanism of the State Council recently issued a notice on strengthening the prevention and control of COVID-19 in port cities, requiring that those who leave land border port cities (except for those connected to Hong Kong and Macao) should hold a negative nucleic acid test certificate within 48 hours, and those who go to land border port cities should have at least one nucleic acid test after arrival.

src: 根据通知，上述要求的时间范围为，从各省区市确定口岸城市范围并公告之日起，至2022年3月15日。

chosen.text: According to the notice, the above requirements are valid from the date when each province, autonomous region and municipality determines the scope of port cities and announces it to March 15, 2022.

src: 此外，通知还提出，有条件的口岸城市可研究在辖区内设置疫情防控缓冲区。

chosen.text: In addition, the notice also proposed that port cities with conditions may study setting up a buffer zone for epidemic prevention and control within their jurisdiction.

src: 国家卫生健康委疾病预防控制局有关负责人介绍，对于一些口岸城市来说，跨境边贸是当地主要经济支柱，双方边民往来频繁。

chosen.text: According to relevant person in charge of the Disease Prevention and Control Bureau of the National Health Commission, for some port cities, cross-border trade is the main economic pillar of the local economy, and there is frequent exchange between the two sides.

src: 实行分区差异化管理政策，由一道防控外溢防线变为两道防线，有望实现关口前移，压缩疫情外溢风险，以最小社会影响、最低社会成本实现疫情防控最大成效。

chosen.text: By implementing a differentiated management policy for zones, the prevention and control of the epidemic will be transformed from one line to two lines, which is expected to achieve the forward shift of the checkpoint, compress the risk of epidemic overflow, and achieve the maximum effect of epidemic prevention and control with the minimum social impact and the lowest social cost.

src: 近期我国发生多起本土聚集性疫情，均是境外疫情经口岸城市输入。

chosen.text: Recently, there have been several outbreaks of local outbreaks in China, which are all imported from overseas epidemics through port cities.

src: 上述通知指出，这暴露出一些地方疫情监测预警不及时、高风险岗位人员闭环管理不落实、定期核酸检测流于形式、冷链物品各环节消杀不到位、集中隔离场所管理不规范、疫情应急处置不够科学精准等问题。

chosen.text: The above-mentioned notice pointed out that this exposed some problems, such as untimely epidemic monitoring and early warning, non-implementation of closed-loop management for high-risk positions, formalities of regular nucleic acid testing, inadequate disinfection in all links of cold-chain items, irregular management of centralized isolation sites, and insufficient scientific and precise emergency handling of the epidemic.

src: 通知要求，从完善口岸城市疫情防控机制、健全疫情监测预警体系、落实边境管控措施等9个方面着力，加快补齐口岸城市防控短板弱项，毫不放松、科学精准做好防控工作，织密扎牢外防输入防线。

chosen.text: The notice required that efforts should be made in nine aspects, including improving the epidemic prevention and control mechanism in port cities, perfecting the epidemic monitoring and early warning system, and implementing border control measures, to accelerate the shortcomings and weaknesses in the prevention and control of port cities, and to do a good job in prevention and control without slackening and scientifically and accurately, and to weave and tighten the defense line of preventing the import of epidemics.

src: 通知强调，各口岸城市要将疫情防控与民生保障工作同步研究、同步部署，公布并畅通民生保障热线，定期排查基本生活物资供应、价格等方面的苗头隐患，及时解决和主动回应群众反映的突出问题。

chosen.text: The notice stressed that the port cities should synchronously study and deploy the epidemic prevention and control and people's livelihood, publish and open the hotline for people's livelihood, regularly investigate the potential risks in the supply of basic living materials, prices, and other aspects, and timely solve and actively respond to the outstanding problems reflected by the masses.

src: 根据通知，其中所指的口岸城市包括开放的陆路、水路、航空口岸所在县（市、区、旗 ） 、 所在市（地、州、盟）及所在直辖市，具体范围由各省（自治区、直辖市）根据疫情防控需要确定并及时公告。

chosen.text: According to the notice, the port cities referred to include the counties (cities, districts, banners) where open land, water and air ports are located, the cities (provinces, autonomous regions, municipalities) where they are located, and the municipalities directly under the Central Government where they are located. The specific scope will be determined by each province (autonomous region, municipalities directly under the Central Government) according to the needs of epidemic prevention and control and announced in a timely manner.

src: 逛书市时，往往能感受到成功学类书籍的火爆。

chosen.text: When visiting the book market, you can often feel the popularity of self-help books.

src: 现今的成功学书籍，很多宣扬的都是“最好原则 ” — —即先假定或暗示你能“做到 ” ， 然后再告诉你需要做到的事情“是什么 ” 。

chosen.text: Many of today's success books promote the "best principle" - that is, first assume or imply that you can "do", and then tell you what you need to do.

src: 等于说一下子越过了“如何做到”这个其实最重要、最根本的环节。

chosen.text: This is equivalent to skipping the most important and fundamental link, that is, "how to do it".

src: 正因如此，这些书都有一个共同的特点 — — 要么就一鼓作气地干到最好，要么就干脆什么也别干；要么就是100，要么就是0；要么你就登泰山，要么你就干脆在原地待着。

chosen.text: That is why these books have a common feature - either you do your best in one go, or you do nothing at all; either it is 100, or it is 0; either you climb Mount Tai, or you just stay where you are.

src: 这种“最好原则 ” ， 让谁看都会承认“正确无比 ” ， 但是99%的人都会被吓倒在起跑线前。

chosen.text: This "best practice" is so perfect that it would be recognized as "perfect" by anyone, but 99% of people will be scared to death at the starting line.

src: 因为这种理论鼓吹的是一种“你要痛下决心，重新做人，来个180度的大转变”的路径，而这恰恰是很多人的致命弱项。

chosen.text: Because this theory advocates a path of "you have to make up your mind, change yourself, and make a 180-degree turn", which is exactly the fatal weakness of many people.

src: 对于墨守成规、因循守旧、拒绝变化的人，你偏偏要在他的耳旁大喊“你要转变 ” ， 无疑是自欺欺人、对牛弹琴之举。

chosen.text: For those who stick to old ways, refuse to change, you have to shout in his ear "you should change", which is undoubtedly self-deception and a waste of time.

src: 绝大多数人都会在“转变”两字面前露怯，裹足不前，难下决心；又或者凭着一时的冲动痛下了“转变”之决心，并勇敢地迈出了第一步，但往往是好景不长，坚持不了多一会儿就败下阵来，难见持续性。

chosen.text: Most people would be afraid of the word "change", and would be hesitant to make a decision; or they would make a decision to "change" on a whim, and bravely take the first step, but often the good times wouldn't last long, and they would fail after a while, and it would be hard to see sustainability.

src: 马三立先生那段著名的《从明天开始》的相声，就是最传神地表现了这一“普遍人性”的经典。

chosen.text: Mr. Ma Sanli’s famous cross-talk “Starting from Tomorrow” is a classic that vividly demonstrates this “universal human nature”.

src: “最好原则”的最大问题在于门槛太高，它往往超越了普通人的能力极限，让绝大多数人“望门兴叹 ” 。

chosen.text: The biggest problem with the "best principle" is that the threshold is too high, which often goes beyond the ability limit of ordinary people, making most people "sigh at the door".

src: 或许 ， “ 次好原则”才是一种有可能让更多普通人走上相对成功之路的途径。

chosen.text: Perhaps, the "second best principle" is a way that may lead more ordinary people to a relatively successful path.

src: “次好原则”的核心在于“降低门槛 ” — —它鼓励的是一种“积小胜为大胜”的理论，即如果做不到100，只做到1也行：因为1永远大于0；如果登不上泰山，只登上你家门口的小沙丘也行，因为那也总比原地踏步强。

chosen.text: The core of the "second best principle" is to "lower the threshold" - it encourages a theory of "accumulating small victories into big victories", that is, if you can't do 100, just do 1: because 1 is always greater than 0; if you can't climb Mount Tai, just climb the small sand dune in front of your house, because that's better than standing still.

src: 总之，只要你做了点什么，就总比不做强。

chosen.text: In short, if you do something, it's better than doing nothing.

src: 由于门槛大幅度降低，因此就多了使普通人做到坚持的可能性，而凡事只要坚持，成功概率也会加大。

chosen.text: Due to the significant reduction of threshold, it is more likely for ordinary people to persist and success probability will increase as long as they persist.

src: 只不过遵循“次好原则”的成功之路，其路程略长一些而已。

chosen.text: It's just that the road to success following the "second best" principle is a little longer.

src: 总而言之 ， “ 最好原则”尽管在表面上打着让所有人都成功的旗号，但它最终能够激励的，实际上还是少数；而“次好原则 ” ， 才能有效激励更多的人，尽可能地让更多人受益。

chosen.text: In short, although the "best principle" is ostensibly designed to make everyone successful, it can ultimately motivate only a small number of people; while the "second best principle" can effectively motivate more people and benefit as many people as possible.

src: 青海湖裸鲤资源蕴藏量今年增加0.71万吨-新华网

chosen.text: The resource reserve of Qinghai Lake naked fish increased by 7,100 tons this year - Xinhuanet

src: 新华社西宁12月11日电（记者骆晓飞、张宏祥）记者从青海省农业农村厅获悉，最新监测结果显示，青海湖裸鲤资源蕴藏量今年较上年增加0.71万吨,达到10.85万吨，与2002年保护初期相比，累计增长40余倍。

chosen.text: Xinhua News Agency, Xining, December 11 (Reporters Luo Xiaofei and Zhang Hongxiang) -- According to the reporter from Qinghai Provincial Department of Agriculture and Rural Affairs, the latest monitoring results show that the resource stock of Qinghai Lake naked carp has increased by 0.71 thousand tons this year compared with last year, reaching 108,500 tons, which is more than 40 times the initial protection in 2002.

src: 青海湖裸鲤俗名“湟鱼 ” ， 是青海湖中特有的珍贵鱼种，对维系青海湖流域“水-鱼-鸟”生态链安全和生物多样性有着举足轻重的作用。

chosen.text: The naked carp in Qinghai Lake, commonly known as “Huang fish”, is a unique and precious fish species in Qinghai Lake, which plays a crucial role in maintaining the safety of the “water-fish-bird” ecological chain and biodiversity in the Qinghai Lake basin.

src: 20世纪六七十年代，受人为大量捕杀、裸鲤繁殖水域环境日益退化等因素影响，青海湖裸鲤数量锐减，2002年青海湖裸鲤资源蕴藏量仅为2592吨。

chosen.text: In the 1960s and 1970s, due to factors such as massive human hunting and the increasingly degraded environment of the spawning waters, the number of naked carp in Qinghai Lake decreased sharply. In 2002, the resource reserve of naked carp in Qinghai Lake was only 2,592 tons.

src: 2004年在《中国物种红色名录》中青海湖裸鲤被列为濒危物种。

chosen.text: In 2004, the Qinghai Lake naked carp was listed as an endangered species in the Red List of Chinese Species.

src: 从2003年起，青海省实施封湖育鱼，禁止任何单位、集体和个人到青海湖及湖区主要河流及支流捕捞裸鲤，禁止销售裸鲤及其制品。

chosen.text: Since 2003, Qinghai Province has implemented the ban on fishing in Qinghai Lake and its main rivers and tributaries, prohibiting any unit, collective or individual from fishing for naked carp in Qinghai Lake and its main rivers and tributaries, and prohibiting the sale of naked carp and its products.

src: 与此同时，通过人工增殖放流以及清理青海湖主要入湖河流河道、设计科学合理的“过鱼通道”等措施持续加大保护力度，青海湖裸鲤资源蕴藏量逐年增加。

chosen.text: Meanwhile, through artificial propagation and release, cleaning up the main rivers of Qinghai Lake, designing scientific and reasonable "fish passage" and other measures to continue to increase protection efforts, the resource reserves of naked carp in Qinghai Lake have increased year by year.

src: 青海省农业农村厅副厅长杨林介绍，截至目前，青海湖裸鲤已累计实施人工增殖放流近1.8亿尾，对青海湖裸鲤资源恢复的贡献率超过23 % 。

chosen.text: Yang Lin, deputy director of the Qinghai Provincial Department of Agriculture and Rural Affairs, said that as of now, nearly 180 million Qinghai Lake nude carp have been artificially bred and released, and the contribution rate to the recovery of Qinghai Lake nude carp resources is more than 23%.

src: 青海三江源地区是我国乃至亚洲重要的生态屏障和水源涵养区，而青海湖是控制西部荒漠化向东蔓延的天然屏障和生态功能区。

chosen.text: The Three Rivers Source Area in Qinghai is an important ecological barrier and water source conservation area in China and even in Asia. Qinghai Lake is a natural barrier and ecological functional area to control the eastward spread of desertification in the west.

src: 为了保护三江源地区和青海湖水域生态环境、保护水生野生动物，维护青藏高原生物多样性，今年以来，青海先后发布长江、黄河、青海湖重点水域禁捕通告，构建起了“一江一河一湖”全面禁捕管理体系。

chosen.text: In order to protect the ecological environment of the Sanjiangyuan region and Qinghai Lake, protect aquatic wildlife, and maintain the biodiversity of the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau, Qinghai has successively issued notices on the ban of fishing in key waters of the Yangtze River, Yellow River and Qinghai Lake since this year, and has established a comprehensive management system for the ban of fishing in "one river, one river and one lake".

src: 形而上学是指通过理性的推理和逻辑去研究不能直接透过感知而得到答案的问题。

chosen.text: The Chinese translation “metaphysics” is taken from the sentence “the metaphysical is called the way, and the physical is called the vessel” in “Yi Jing • Xi Ci Shang Chuan”. It was translated by the Japanese Tetsusaburo Inoue (Meiji era) from the word “metaphysic”.

src: 伦理学是对人类道德生活进行系统性思考和研究的学科；在这里，道德定义为一群人或一种文化所认可的所有行为准则。

chosen.text: Ethics is the discipline of systematic thought and study of the moral life of human beings; here, morality is defined as all the codes of conduct that are accepted by a group of people or a culture.

src: 主要分为元伦理学（抽象地研究伦理理论或批判的本质）、规范伦理学（评判各种不同的道德观，并且对于正确或错误行为给出道德准则建议。

chosen.text: It is divided into meta-ethics (the abstract study of the nature of ethical theories or critiques) and normative ethics (the evaluation of different moral views and the giving of moral prescriptions about what is right or wrong to do.

src: 它研究人们应该遵守什么样式的道德行为准则）、应用伦理学（将伦理理论应用于实际生活状况的学术，包括生物伦理学、政治伦理学等）、描述伦理学（搜集关于人们怎样生活的信息，从观察到的样式来作总结。

chosen.text: It studies what kind of moral code people should follow), applied ethics (the academic study of applying ethical theory to real-life situations, including bioethics, political ethics, etc.), descriptive ethics (the collection of information about how people live, from observed patterns).

src: 它对于伦理的检视不是从预想的理论出发，而是调查实际道德主体（moral agent）所做出、并且被观察到的真实抉择，促成了这决择的所有道德因素，它研讨社会族群所持有的伦理观）。

chosen.text: Its examination of ethics is not based on anticipated theories, but on real choices made by actual moral agents (moral agents) and observed, with all moral factors that contribute to these decisions, it examines the ethics held by social groups).

src: 本人在此衷心感谢各位朋友在我们亲人遇难后的30多年漫长期间内所给予的人道救助，尤其是在我1994年初曾以个人名义向国内外友人发出过人道救助呼吁以来，迄今为止未曾中断的救助。

chosen.text: I would like to express my heartfelt gratitude to all friends for their humanitarian assistance over the long period of more than 30 years after our relatives died, especially since I had issued a call for humanitarian assistance to domestic and foreign friends in my personal name in early 1994, the assistance has not been interrupted so far.

src: 现如今绝大多数遇难者的老父母均已谢世，遗孤们也已长大成家就业。

chosen.text: Nowadays, most of the parents of the victims have passed away, and the orphans have grown up and got married and found jobs.

src: 是你们的义举帮助我们这些蒙难家庭度过了最为艰难的时刻。

chosen.text: It is your generosity that has helped us through the most difficult of times.

src: 目前新冠疫情正在全球肆虐，大多数的捐款者也已年届退休。

chosen.text: At present, the COVID-19 pandemic is raging around the world, and most of the donors are already retired.

src: 因此，我恳切地请求你们中止给我们难属——天安门母亲群体人道捐款，这项人道救助活动早就应该画上完美的句号了。

chosen.text: Therefore, I earnestly request you to suspend the humanitarian donation to our group of Tiananmen Mothers, and this humanitarian assistance activity should have been perfectly ended long ago.

src: 我将永远铭记你们的爱心，并坚信你们的义举必将为历史铭记。

chosen.text: I will always remember your love and firmly believe that your righteous deeds will be remembered in history.

src: 由于种种原因，我只能以此方式表达自己的意愿，请朋友们谅解！

chosen.text: For various reasons, I can only express my wishes in this way, so please understand!

src: 请接受我诚挚的祝福。

chosen.text: Please accept my sincere best wishes.

src: 1998年，MCDF设立《六四孤儿教育基金》，执行11年后，于2009年，在所有六四孤儿都大学毕业后，MCDF继而设立《六四孤苦老人特困户救助基金》，并一直执行至今。

chosen.text: In 1998, the MCDF established the "June 4 Orphan Education Fund". After 11 years of implementation, in 2009, after all the June 4 orphans graduated from university, the MCDF then established the "June 4 Orphan and Elderly Poor Relief Fund", which has been implemented to this day.

src: 这些项目的资金，主要来自六四当年的校园和社会捐款，来自个人的慷慨捐助，并受到兄弟大学民主基金会的支持。

chosen.text: The funding for these projects comes mainly from campus and community donations from the year of the Tiananmen Square massacre, generous donations from individuals, and support from the Foundation for Democracy at Sister Universities.

chosen.text: Until last year, after 31 years, the victims of the June 4th Movement finally received a portion of the donations collected in Hong Kong in the name of the June 4th Movement.

chosen.text: We understand that Mr. Ding stopped the donation for June 4th is for the donors. We are indeed some retired people, and our income is not as abundant as before retirement. We would like to express our gratitude to Mr. Ding's letter "To a Friend".

src: 中沙策展人携手举办沙特首届当代艺术双年展-新华网

chosen.text: Chinese and Saudi curators team up to hold Saudi Arabia's first contemporary art biennale - Xinhuanet

src: 新华社利雅得12月12日电（记者王海洲 胡冠）沙特阿拉伯首届当代艺术双年展 — — 迪里耶当代艺术双年展，于11日在位于沙特首都利雅得西北部的迪里耶JAX艺术区正式向公众开放，共有来自沙特、中国等地的64位艺术家参展。

chosen.text: Xinhua News Agency, Riyadh, December 12 (Reporters Wang Haizhou and Hu Guan) The first contemporary art biennale in Saudi Arabia - the Diriyah Contemporary Art Biennale was officially opened to the public on the 11th in the Diriyah JAX Art District in the northwest of Riyadh, the capital of Saudi Arabia. A total of 64 artists from Saudi Arabia, China and other places participated in the exhibition.

src: 本次双年展由沙特迪里耶双年展基金会和中国UCCA尤伦斯当代艺术中心联合策划，中国UCCA尤伦斯当代艺术中心馆长田霏宇担任艺术总监。

chosen.text: This biennale was jointly organized by the Saudi Diriyah Biennial Foundation and the UCCA Center for Contemporary Art in China, with Tian Fei-yu, director of the UCCA Center for Contemporary Art in China, serving as artistic director.

src: 据策展团队介绍，本次双年展的主题为“摸着石头过河 ” ， 隐喻社会经济转型时期所采取的改革策略，也反映沙特社会文化发展的当下境遇。

chosen.text: According to the curator team, the theme of this biennale is "crossing the river by feeling the stones", which implies the reform strategy taken during the period of social and economic transformation, and also reflects the current situation of Saudi Arabia's social and cultural development.

src: 本次双年展占地近12000平方米，展厅横跨六个相互连接的建筑，以六个单元呈现 ： 《 摸着石头过河 》 《 传承作为实验 》 《 边缘思考 》 《 走向公众 》 《 美丽新世界》以及《论艺术的精神 》 。

chosen.text: The biennial covers an area of nearly 12,000 square meters, and the exhibition hall spans six interconnected buildings, which are presented in six units: "Crossing the River by Touching Stones", "Inheritance as Experiment", "Thinking at the Edge", "Towards the Public", "A Beautiful New World" and "On the Spirit of Art".

src: 其中，27位沙特艺术家的作品数量占本次展品总量的四成以上，囊括绘画、装置艺术和表演艺术等多种形式；12位中国艺术家的作品同样备受关注，有的艺术家以新颖的方式使用回收材料进行创作，例如徐冰在《背后的故事系列之溪山无尽图 》 （ 2014）中，用废弃物重构了一幅经典山水画。

chosen.text: Among them, the works of 27 Saudi Arabian artists accounted for more than 40% of the total number of exhibits, including paintings, installation art and performance art; the works of 12 Chinese artists are also of great concern. Some artists use recycled materials in a novel way, such as Xu Bing, who reconstructed a classic landscape painting with waste materials in “The Story Behind Series: A Picture of Endless Mountains and Rivers” (2014).

src: 迪里耶双年展基金会首席执行官巴克利表示，希望本届双年展能够建立国际对话，让全球观众有机会了解沙特蓬勃发展的文化产业和创意社区，加强互动往来。

chosen.text: Buckley, CEO of the Diriyah Biennale Foundation, said that he hoped that this biennale would establish an international dialogue, giving global audiences the opportunity to learn about Saudi Arabia's booming cultural industry and creative community, and strengthen interaction.

src: 田霏宇说 ： “ 双年展的目标是双重的，既能让沙特当代艺术参与全球对话，也能让沙特观众融入当代艺术世界 。 ”

chosen.text: Tian Feiyu said, "The goal of the Biennale is twofold, to allow Saudi contemporary art to participate in global dialogue and to allow Saudi audiences to be integrated into the world of contemporary art. "

src: 据了解，在双年展开幕周期间还将举办系列讲座，艺术家、策展人和创意行业的意见领袖将就跨文化交流、当代艺术发展等主题展开讨论。

chosen.text: It is understood that a series of lectures will also be held during the opening period of the biennale, and artists, curators and creative industry opinion leaders will discuss topics such as cross-cultural exchange and contemporary art development.

src: 云南：统筹规范乡村公益性岗位管理-新华网

chosen.text: Yunnan: Coordinated and standardized management of rural public welfare positions - Xinhuanet

src: 新华社昆明12月12日电（记者林碧锋）为持续做好脱贫人口就业帮扶，巩固拓展脱贫攻坚成果，云南省日前出台促进乡村振兴乡村公益性岗位管理相关政策，助力全面推进乡村振兴。

chosen.text: Xinhua News Agency, Kunming, December 12 (Reporter Lin Bifeng) In order to continue to do a good job in employment assistance for people who have been lifted out of poverty and consolidate and expand the achievements of poverty alleviation, Yunnan Province has recently issued relevant policies on promoting rural revitalization and management of public welfare positions in villages, which will help promote the comprehensive revitalization of rural areas.

src: 云南省人社厅有关负责人介绍，目前，云南共开发44.83万个乡村公益性岗位，用于安置脱贫劳动力等农村困难群体就业，在帮助脱贫群众实现就业增收、巩固脱贫攻坚成果、有效提升乡村各项公共服务能力等方面发挥重要作用。

chosen.text: According to the relevant person in charge of the Yunnan Provincial Human Resources and Social Security Department, at present, Yunnan has developed a total of 448,300 rural public welfare posts, which are used to place poverty-stricken labor force and other rural disadvantaged groups, and play an important role in helping the poverty-stricken people to increase their income, consolidate the achievements of poverty eradication, and effectively improve the public service capabilities of the villages.

src: 此次新规由云南人社、乡村振兴、财政等七部门联合印发，主要对基层招聘乡村公益性岗位人员的对象范围、资金管理、岗位开发、岗位管理等方面进行统一规范。

chosen.text: This new regulation was jointly issued by seven departments in Yunnan Province, including the Human Resources and Social Security Bureau, Rural Revitalization Bureau, and Finance Bureau. It mainly standardizes the scope of recruitment for village-level public welfare positions, fund management, position development, and position management.

src: 在岗位开发设置方面，新规明确，按照“按需设岗、以岗定人、动态管理、总量控制 ” “ 谁开发、谁使用、谁负责”及“一人一岗、自愿公开、统一管理”的原则进行设置。

chosen.text: In terms of post development and setting, the new rules clearly state that the posts should be set up in accordance with the principles of "post setting according to needs, determining personnel according to posts, dynamic management, total quantity control", "whoever develops, whoever uses, whoever is responsible" and "one person, one post, voluntary disclosure, unified management".

src: 招聘程序必须按照公告、申报、审核、公示、聘用、岗前培训及安排上岗等步骤进行。

chosen.text: The recruitment process must be carried out in accordance with the announcement, declaration, review, publicity, employment, pre-job training and arrangement for work.

src: 此外，新规还明确了乡村公益性岗位主要开发部门的具体职责、乡村公益性岗位的补贴标准和补贴方式，规定各乡村公益性岗位开发部门应为乡村公益性岗位安置人员购买意外伤害商业保险；要求有关部门定期对乡村公益性岗位补贴发放情况进行监督。

chosen.text: In addition, the new rules also clarify the specific responsibilities of the main development departments for rural public welfare positions, the subsidy standards and methods for rural public welfare positions, and stipulate that each rural public welfare position development department should purchase commercial accident insurance for rural public welfare positions; require relevant departments to regularly supervise the subsidy distribution of rural public welfare positions.

src: 二、虽然右派在历史上有得志时代，但不长，所以短是因为给点儿阳光就灿烂，喝点儿开水就出汗；稍得志便得陇望蜀，遭打击便毛将焉附。

The reason for the short period was that they were successful after a little sunshine, and they would sweat after drinking a little hot water. src: 但实事求是来说，右派在社会进步过程中起到过积极作用。

src: 从结束文革定义真理标准，发展经济提高科技以及促进行政制度化和人权保障等方面，右派的积极意义不该否定。

chosen.text: From the end of the Cultural Revolution, defining the criterion of truth, developing the economy and improving science and technology, as well as promoting administrative institutionalization and human rights protection, the positive significance of the right wing should not be denied.

src: 三、就我而言，尽管不完全同意李伟东的有些说法，但我很在意他的说法，也很尊重李伟东这个人；因为他是认真的，他对中国是认真的，对中国的社会问题也是认真看待的。

chosen.text: Third, as far as I am concerned, although I do not completely agree with some of Li Weidong’s statements, I am very concerned about his statements and I respect Li Weidong as a person; because he is serious, he is serious about China, and he is serious about China’s social problems.

src: 但我反对他的反共理论，我认为反必要革命，革命则必然导致社会动荡，民生受损，政治团体鱼龙混杂泥沙俱下，再就是外国趁虚而入。

chosen.text: However, I oppose his anti-communist theory. I believe that anti-essential revolution will inevitably lead to social unrest, damage people's livelihoods, and political groups will be mixed with good and bad. Moreover, foreign countries will take advantage of the situation.

src: 四、改变或改善中国要有耐心和为国为民负责的态度，政治投机企图火中取栗者，那不是右派，是混蛋。

chosen.text: Fourth, to change or improve China, we must have patience and a sense of responsibility for the country and the people. Those who try to make political speculation and take advantage of the situation are not rightists, but bastards.

src: 再聊聊左。

chosen.text: Let's talk about the left.

src: 左，其实是一帮时代和政治的弃儿。

chosen.text: The left is actually a group of people who have been abandoned by time and politics.

src: 如果说右具有对社会的积极意义，共产党还会在需要的时候听取一些右的言论和分析他们的思想，那么左就没这造化了，因为左所要的正是共产党所扔掉的糟粕！

chosen.text: If the right has positive significance for society, the Communist Party will listen to some right-wing speeches and analyze their thoughts when necessary, but the left doesn't have this privilege because what the left wants is exactly what the Communist Party has thrown away!

src: 五、最近看到一些朋友边怼反贼边驳左癫，还挺动真气，我觉得大可不必。

chosen.text: Five, I recently saw some friends who were fighting against the counter-revolutionaries and refuting the leftists at the same time, and they were quite angry. I think it is unnecessary.

src: 跟汉奸跟左癫都不要试图讲理，都是一根儿筋，无理可讲。

chosen.text: Don't try to reason with Han traitors and leftists. They are all one piece of flesh, and there is no reason to talk.

src: 也不要试图证明咱们是正确的，更不要想着让反贼和左癫承认，何必呢？

chosen.text: Don't try to prove that we are right, and don't even think about making the counter-revolutionaries and the leftists admit it, why bother?

src: 我这样告诉朋友们：当反贼骂你五毛，当左癫骂你右狗的时候，恰恰证明我们的这条中间道路是正确的！

chosen.text: I told my friends that when the traitors call you a "50-cent" and the leftists call you a "rightist dog", it proves that our middle path is correct!

src: 许多人少年时候也有理想，老了之后，却忘了理想，或追求理想，却沦为偏执。

chosen.text: Many people also have ideals when they are young, but when they grow old, they forget their ideals, or pursue their ideals, but become paranoid.

src: 和理想渐行渐远，甚至屠龙少年终成恶龙。

chosen.text: It is getting further and further away from the ideal, and even the dragon-slaying boy will eventually become a dragon.

src: 左右我觉得一般是指约束和自由，中国从历史文化的先天基因导致中国整体应该是偏左。

chosen.text: I think that "left" and "right" generally refer to constraints and freedom, and China should be left-leaning as a result of its historical and cultural genes.

src: 而国内右派自由，注重效率和发展，左派加强监管，更注重公平以及安全。

chosen.text: The right-wing in the country is liberal, emphasizes efficiency and development, while the left-wing strengthens supervision and pays more attention to fairness and security.

src: 现在社会总体希望更注重公平，同时中美相争，偏左是肯定的，估计还得持续很多年。

chosen.text: Nowadays, society generally hopes to pay more attention to fairness. At the same time, China and the United States are in conflict. It is certain that the left-leaning will continue for many years.

src: 近两年，美帝对华为芯片的封锁和围堵，不仅让华为陷入前所未有的困境，也让“美系”企业遭遇巨大的损失。

chosen.text: In the past two years, the blockade and encirclement of Huawei chips by the United States has not only put Huawei in an unprecedented predicament, but also caused huge losses to "American" enterprises.

src: 美帝打压中国芯片产业，要求自家企业及盟友国相关企业同时对我国芯片产业进行封锁，直接导致的后果就是全球芯片供应商的订单和利润受到影响，造成芯片生产企业的研发投入降低、产能下降，从而造成了全球范围内芯片供应链的短缺的紊乱。

chosen.text: The United States suppresses China's chip industry and requires its own enterprises and relevant enterprises of its allies to block China's chip industry at the same time, which directly leads to the consequences that the orders and profits of global chip suppliers are affected, resulting in the research and development investment and production capacity of chip production enterprises decreasing, and thus causing the shortage and disorder of the global chip supply chain.

src: 如今“缺芯”已经波及到了全球各大行业，比如车企停产、手机涨价，几乎所有用到芯片的行业都深受其害。

chosen.text: Now, the "chip shortage" has affected all major industries around the world, such as the suspension of production of automobile companies and the price increase of mobile phones. Almost all industries that use chips are deeply affected.

src: 为了掌握“芯片”自主权，越来越多国家的科技巨头开始走向“去美化”的道路。

chosen.text: In order to master the "chip" autonomy, more and more technology giants in many countries have begun to take the path of "de-Americanization".

src: 为了牢牢把控全球半导体控制权，牵制中国半导体行业的发展，最近老美动作频频，又是主持“芯片峰会”；又是邀请64国巨头成立半导体联盟，并拔款扶持美国本土科技巨头，比如，美帝老牌科技巨头英特尔为了夺回在芯片领域的主导地位，斥资200亿美元在美国亚利桑那州建2座晶圆加工厂，并对外开放芯片代工业务。

chosen.text: In order to firmly control the global semiconductor control right and restrain the development of China's semiconductor industry, the old Americans have recently taken frequent actions, and they are holding the "Chip Summit"; they are also inviting the giants of 64 countries to establish a semiconductor alliance, and they are allocating funds to support the local technology giants in the United States. For example, the old technology giant Intel in the United States spent $20 billion to build two wafer processing plants in Arizona, United States, in order to regain the leading position in the chip field, and opened the chip OEM business to the outside world.

src: 当大多数人都以为，英特尔此番举动将对台积电造成一定冲击，并很有可能抢走台积电的“饭碗”。

chosen.text: Most people thought that Intel's move would have a certain impact on TSMC and would likely take away TSMC's "job".

src: 之所以这么肯定，是因为，英特尔作为美帝老牌科技巨头，在半导体领域深耕几十年，拥有大量的人才队伍和技术储备，必定能在短期内迅速崛起，打败台积电。

chosen.text: This is because Intel, as a long-established technology giant in the United States, has been deeply involved in the semiconductor industry for decades, has a large number of talent teams and technical reserves, and is sure to rise quickly in the short term and defeat Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company.

src: 然而，对于英特尔的这个决定，台积电创始人张忠谋却不屑一顾。

chosen.text: However, for Intel's decision, the founder of TSMC, Jerry Yang, did not care.

src: 在今年四月举行的“2021大师智库论坛”上，张忠谋语出惊人，对于英特尔斥资建晶圆厂这个举动，张忠谋毫无顾忌直言：英特尔建芯片代工厂，相当讽刺。

chosen.text: At the "2021 Master Think Tank Forum" held in April this year, Zhang Zhonglou said something shocking. He said without hesitation that Intel's investment to build a wafer factory was quite ironic.

src: 张忠谋之所以对英特尔进军晶圆领域颇为不屑，是因为张忠谋对30多年前台积电与英特尔的一段恩怨依然耿耿于怀。

chosen.text: The reason why Morris Chang is quite disdainful of Intel’s entry into the wafer field is that he still holds a grudge over a grudge between TSMC and Intel more than 30 years ago.

src: 上世纪六七十年代，英特尔一直是美帝制造业中的明珠，雄居全球巅峰的位置，是世界半导体领域的霸主。

chosen.text: In the 1960s and 1970s, Intel has always been a pearl in the manufacturing industry of the United States, occupying the top position in the world, and is the world's semiconductor field hegemon.

src: 到上世纪80年代，世界半导体高端芯片一直被少数强者掌握。

chosen.text: By the 1980s, the world's high-end semiconductor chips have been controlled by a few strong players.

src: 当时半导体行业以IDM模式为特征，芯片从设计、制造到封测都是由一家工厂来完成，英特尔就是那个时代的代表。

chosen.text: At that time, the semiconductor industry was characterized by the IDM model, and chips were designed, manufactured and packaged by a single factory. Intel was the representative of that era.

src: 然而这样的模式让一些小企业不堪重负，很多半导体创业者面对巨额的产线建设费用只能望而却步。

chosen.text: However, such a model has put some small businesses under great pressure. Many semiconductor entrepreneurs have been deterred from entering the market due to huge production line construction costs.

src: 在市场需求的感召下，进入80年代后，芯片行业开始出现分工合作的现象，1984年张忠谋听说有专门做芯片设计的公司，便认为既然有专门做设计的，那么就可以成立一家专门用于晶圆制造的工厂。

chosen.text: In the 1980s, inspired by market demand, the chip industry began to see a phenomenon of division of labor and cooperation. In 1984, when Morris Chang heard that there was a company specializing in chip design, he thought that since there was a company specializing in design, then a factory dedicated to wafer manufacturing could be established.

src: 不久之后，张忠谋的设想变成了现实，台积电应运而生。

chosen.text: Soon after, Zhang Chongmei’s vision became a reality, and TSMC was born.

src: 台积电把主营业务瞄准了“晶圆加工”这个单一环节，不进行设计，只提供晶圆制造的代工服务。

chosen.text: TSMC has focused its main business on the single link of “wafer processing”. It does not design, but only provides wafer manufacturing services.

src: 当时刚创立的台积电，在英特尔这个巨无霸面前就是小喽啰。

chosen.text: At that time, the newly established Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company was just a small player in the face of the giant Intel.

src: 为了获取资本支持，张忠谋就曾找英特尔投资，但当时英特尔一听说台积电只做芯片行业的制造环节，显然有些自视甚高，看不起台积电，果断拒绝对台积电进行投资。

chosen.text: In order to obtain capital support, Zhang Chongmou once sought investment from Intel, but at that time, Intel, after hearing that TSMC only did the manufacturing link of the chip industry, was obviously very arrogant and looked down on TSMC, and resolutely refused to invest in TSMC.

src: 张忠谋也认定英特尔当时是看不起晶圆制程服务的。

chosen.text: Zhang Chongmei also believed that Intel did not respect the wafer process service at that time.

src: 没想到当年看不起晶圆制造服务的巨头，如今却也要开始做晶圆代工。

chosen.text: It is not surprising that the giant who looked down on wafer manufacturing services would also start to do wafer fabrication.

src: 所以，张忠谋觉得英特尔进入晶圆代工很讽刺。

chosen.text: So, Zhang Chongmei thought that Intel’s entry into wafer foundry was very ironic.

src: 如今台积电的市值已经超过了英特尔。

chosen.text: Now, TSMC’s market value has surpassed that of Intel.

src: 面对台积电的强势进攻，英特尔自然也是不敢固步自封。

chosen.text: Faced with the strong attack of Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company, Intel naturally dared not to be complacent.

src: 如今，台积电已经向着3nm芯片冲刺，而英特尔仍然停留在7年前的14nm。

chosen.text: Now, TSMC has rushed towards 3nm chips, while Intel is still stuck at 14nm seven years ago.

src: 想要赶超其实并非易事。

chosen.text: It is not easy to catch up.

src: 不等了

chosen.text: No more waiting.

src: “不建议在城市进行观测，可以在郊区或是乡村选择一个海拔高、光害小、面向东北方向的视野开阔之处，然后耐心地等到月亮落下后，目视观测即可。

chosen.text: "It is not recommended to observe in the city, you can choose a high altitude, low light pollution and open view in the northeast direction in the suburbs or countryside, and then wait patiently until the moon falls, and then observe with the naked eye.

src: 需要注意的是，双子座流星雨朝各个方向的流量都很大，观测时不用一直盯着双子座流星雨的辐射点看。

chosen.text: It should be noted that the Geminid meteor shower has a large flow in all directions, so there is no need to keep staring at the radiant point of the Geminid meteor shower during observation.

src: 喜欢摄影的朋友要想拍摄出绚丽的‘流星雨大片 ’ ， 最好选择广角、大光圈的镜头，拍摄时使用高ISO和最大光圈。

chosen.text: For those who like photography, if you want to take a brilliant "meteor shower film", it is best to choose a wide-angle, large aperture lens, and use high ISO and maximum aperture when shooting.

src: 基于稳定性和持续性考虑，三脚架、备用电池和快门线也必不可少 。 ”

chosen.text: Based on stability and continuity considerations, tripods, spare batteries and shutter release cables are also essential. "

src: 激光电视和传统电视在市场定位上有何差异？

chosen.text: What is the difference between laser TV and traditional TV in terms of market positioning?

src: 以我的理解，题主所说的传统电视应该指的就是液晶电视，而激光电视和液晶电视在市场定位上的差异，主要有以下两点：

chosen.text: In my understanding, the traditional television referred to by the main question should be the liquid crystal TV. The market positioning differences between laser TV and liquid crystal TV mainly include the following two points:

src: 第一，激光电视更聚焦大屏市场。

chosen.text: First, laser TVs are more focused on the large screen market.

src: 相比液晶电视全面铺开的市场定位，激光电视显然更聚焦大屏市场，或者说激光电视本身就是为大屏而生的产物。

chosen.text: Compared with the market positioning of LCD TVs, laser TVs are obviously more focused on the large screen market, or rather, laser TVs are products that are born for large screens.

src: 目前，主流液晶电视尺寸多在55英寸到65英寸，而激光电视的尺寸一般在75英寸以上，最大的超过100英寸，充分满足用户对大屏彩电的需求。

chosen.text: At present, the mainstream LCD TV size is generally between 55 inches and 65 inches, while the size of laser TV is generally above 75 inches, and the largest is more than 100 inches, which fully meets the user's demand for large screen TVs.

src: 近年来，激光电视在全球的出货量和销量占比都在不断增加，在80英寸及以上总体电视销量中占比超六成。

chosen.text: In recent years, the shipment and sales volume of laser TVs have been increasing worldwide, accounting for more than 60% of the overall TV sales volume of 80 inches and above.

src: 根据中怡康的预测，2020年，激光电视市场销量增长将超过140%，继续保持高速增长。

chosen.text: According to the prediction of CIC, in 2020, the sales volume of laser TV market will increase by more than 140% and continue to maintain high growth.

src: 之所以在大屏市场有如此好的成绩，主要归功于激光电视在护眼方面的出色表现。

chosen.text: The reason for such good performance in the large screen market is mainly due to the excellent performance of laser TVs in terms of eye protection.

src: 基于激光电视漫反射的成像原理，激光光源发出的光线并不直射入眼球，相比液晶电视的背光源发光，成像过程更接近自然条件下物体的成像过程，对眼睛产生的刺激也更小。

chosen.text: Based on the imaging principle of diffuse reflection of laser TV, the light emitted by the laser light source does not directly enter the eyeball. Compared with the backlight source of LCD TV, the imaging process is closer to the imaging process of objects under natural conditions, and the stimulation to the eyes is also smaller.

src: 中国电子技术标准化研究院赛西实验室和北京协和医院眼科专家，通过人群相同条件下观看激光电视和液晶电视的严格对比试验，得出了144组测试数据。

chosen.text: The China Electronics Standardization Institute’s Sai Xi Laboratory and Beijing Union Medical College Hospital’s ophthalmology experts obtained 144 sets of test data through strict comparative experiments under the same conditions for watching laser TVs and LCD TVs.

src: 数据证实：激光电视的确具有很强的护眼特性，在特定方面甚至具有一定的改善作用。

chosen.text: The data confirms that laser TVs do have strong eye protection characteristics, and even have a certain improvement effect in specific aspects.

src: 在视力健康越来越受重视的当下，激光电视不仅凭借护眼优势吸引了越来越多用户，也打开了彩电市场的另一个突破口。

chosen.text: In the current situation where visual health is receiving increasing attention, laser TVs have not only attracted more and more users with their eye protection advantages, but also opened another breakthrough in the color TV market.

src: 第二，激光电视更聚焦高端市场。

chosen.text: Second, laser TVs are more focused on the high-end market.

src: 与液晶电视价格不断下探相反，目前市售激光电视的价格大多在万元以上，随着尺寸和光源的升级，价格逐步攀升。

chosen.text: In contrast to the continuous decline in the price of LCD TVs, the current market price of laser TVs is mostly above 10,000 yuan, and the price gradually climbs with the upgrade of size and light source.

src: 激光电视凭什么卖这么贵呢？

chosen.text: Why is the laser TV so expensive?

src: 肯定是有道理的。

chosen.text: It's definitely a valid point.

src: 在光源和技术水平的不断发展下，激光电视有很多液晶电视和投影都无法实现的优势。

chosen.text: With the continuous development of light sources and technology levels, laser TV has many advantages that liquid crystal TVs and projectors cannot achieve.

src: 凭借超短焦距投影技术，激光电视的投影距离相对传统投影设备来说要更短，能够在短距离内实现100英寸大屏体验，所需空间不大，而且主机小巧，占用地方很小。

chosen.text: With ultra-short focal length projection technology, the projection distance of laser TV is shorter than that of traditional projection equipment, which can achieve a 100-inch large screen experience in a short distance, requires little space, and the main unit is small and occupies very little space.

src: 在亮度方面，大品牌激光电视可以达到2000以上的流明。

chosen.text: In terms of brightness, big brand laser TVs can reach more than 2000 lumens.

src: 加之发热量更低，对设备损耗小，电视的使用寿命也更长。

chosen.text: In addition, the heat is lower, so the equipment loss is small, and the service life of the TV is longer.

src: 除此之外，很多高端激光电视机型还搭载了真4K超高清画质、人工智能系统、仿生屏等众多前沿技术，能够给用户带来更震撼的视听体验。

chosen.text: In addition, many high-end laser TV models also have true 4K ultra-high definition picture quality, artificial intelligence systems, and bionic screens, among many other cutting-edge technologies, which can bring users more shocking audio-visual experience.

src: 谈不上伪需求，而是需求细分的产物，论画质和投入产出比，激光电视不是影音玩家的菜，想兼顾大屏和观看环境不足，可以尝试，凡事皆有利弊，权衡过后自己判断即可，就怕听信一面之词。

chosen.text: It is not a pseudo-demand, but a product of demand segmentation. In terms of picture quality and input-output ratio, laser TV is not suitable for audio-visual players. If you want to balance the large screen and insufficient viewing environment, you can try it. There are pros and cons to everything. After weighing the pros and cons, you can make your own judgment. Just be afraid of believing one-sided words.

src: 简单说，超广角近焦投影机--激光电视，为了贴近幕布，不得不使用价格昂贵的超广角透镜和反射镜，这不符合光学最佳设计。

chosen.text: In short, the ultra-wide-angle near-focus projector - laser TV, in order to get close to the screen, it has to use expensive ultra-wide-angle lenses and reflectors, which is not in line with the best optical design.

src: 为了屏蔽部分环境光，使用微结构的菲涅尔幕布，代价高昂，80寸的价格基本能换个65寸液晶。

chosen.text: In order to block some ambient light, the use of micro-structured Fresnel curtains is costly, and the price of 80 inches can basically be exchanged for a 65-inch LCD.

src: 还有一点，我特别讨厌投影厂商拿漫反射对眼睛好这种当卖点，拜托，眼睛能够看到的幕布上的光线对于眼睛而言就是直射光，你漫反射到天花板上，眼睛也看不到，非要较真液晶电视也是漫“直射”，打开电视天花板不也被照亮吗？

chosen.text: And one more thing, I really hate it when projection manufacturers use the fact that diffuse reflection is good for the eyes as a selling point. Please tell me, the light on the screen that the eye can see is direct light to the eye. You diffuse it onto the ceiling, but the eye cannot see it. So you insist that LCD TVs are also "direct" light? The ceiling will be illuminated when you turn on the TV, right?

src: 而且，投影幕布如果不是漫反射，根本成不了像。

chosen.text: Moreover, if the projection screen is not diffused reflection, it cannot form an image.

src: 恰恰被忽略了高增益幕布的热斑（光斑）效应，某一角度大量光线反射到眼睛，那才是真难受。

chosen.text: The hot spot (light spot) effect of high gain screen is ignored, and a lot of light is reflected to the eyes at a certain angle, which is really uncomfortable.

src: 小雨伞买保险，靠谱吗?

chosen.text: Is it reliable to buy insurance for a small umbrella?

src: 小雨伞是一个互联网的保险经纪平台。

chosen.text: Little Umbrella is an Internet insurance brokerage platform.

src: 从设置条件来看：按照《保险经纪机构监管规定(2015年修订)》提示来看，成为保险经纪公司的，必须满足三个关键词：股东、发起人最近3年无重大违法记录、最低限额为人民币5000万元才可以成立、必须经过中国保监会同意。

chosen.text: From the perspective of the conditions for establishment: according to the prompt of the Regulations on the Supervision of Insurance Brokerage Institutions (Revised in 2015), to become an insurance brokerage company, it must meet three key conditions: shareholders and sponsors must have no major illegal records in the past three years, the minimum limit is RMB50 million, and it must be approved by the China Insurance Regulatory Commission.

src: 这三条其实就是很苛刻的，总结起来就是要有实力，要经过银保监会（监管全国内的保险公司、银行）的国家权威部门批准、股东要有良好的作风，作为保险经纪公司的小雨伞保险，投保者是不用过多质疑小雨伞保险是正规的与否，毕竟有这3条门槛，不是什么保险公司都能达到的。

chosen.text: These three requirements are actually very strict. In summary, they require that you have the ability, and be approved by the national authority of the China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission (CBIRC), which oversees all insurance companies and banks in China, shareholders must have good conduct, and as an insurance brokerage company, Little Umbrella Insurance, policyholders do not need to question whether Little Umbrella Insurance is legitimate or not, after all, these three thresholds are not something any insurance company can meet.

src: 在这一点上，还不错，是值得信赖的。

chosen.text: It's good at this point, it's reliable.

src: 从保险产品来看：小雨伞保险就是一个保险超市，很多公司的明星重疾险都在这家平台上出售，如最新上架的和泰超级玛丽5号重疾险，理赔方和承保方都是和泰人寿，小雨伞保险只是第三方中介，不用质疑它的靠谱性。

chosen.text: From the perspective of insurance products, Xiaoyuanshu Insurance is an insurance supermarket, and many companies’ star critical illness insurance are sold on this platform, such as the latest He Tai Super Mary No. 5 Critical Illness Insurance, where the claim settlement party and the underwriter are both He Tai Life Insurance, and Xiaoyuanshu Insurance is just a third-party intermediary, so there is no need to question its reliability.

src: 从缴费模式来看：互联网平台的产品，因为少了营业网点的经营费用，和业务员工资的成本，所以互联网产品普遍性价比比较高，而且缴费方式灵活，支持月缴，减轻投保人的缴费压力，同时可以最大限度的撬动保险的杠杆。

chosen.text: From the perspective of payment mode, the products of Internet platforms have a relatively high cost performance because they have less operating expenses and business staff salary costs. Moreover, the payment method is flexible, supporting monthly payment, reducing the payment pressure of the policyholder, and at the same time, it can maximize the leverage of insurance.

src: 这点还是非常不错的。

chosen.text: That's a very good thing.

src: 可以考虑。

chosen.text: It can be considered.

src: 从业务员专业度来看：这点尤为重要，因为保险是一个专业度要求非常强的行业，很多互联网产品客户可以自己投保，这种就会存在很多的误区，在健康告知和职业这块，非保险从业人员往往在投保的时候会添加自己的主观意识，觉得自己健康或者符合，这样容易存在很多理赔隐患，有可能被拒赔的风险。

chosen.text: From the perspective of salesperson professionalism: This is particularly important because insurance is a highly professional industry. Many Internet products can be insured by customers themselves, which will lead to many misunderstandings. In terms of health declaration and occupation, non-insurance practitioners often add their subjective consciousness when insuring, thinking that they are healthy or meet the requirements, which will easily lead to many hidden claims and may be rejected.

src: 我自己曾在“腾讯微保”（和小雨伞一样，也是互联网保险经纪平台）做过保险电话销售，非常负责任的告诉大家。

chosen.text: I myself have done insurance telemarketing at "Tencent Micro Insurance" (just like Xiao Yu Shuang, it is also an Internet insurance brokerage platform), and I am very responsible to tell everyone.

src: 互联网的保险是真的，也靠谱，不靠谱的是人，互联网渠道没有专业的从业人员，也有很多的销售误导。

src: 越南人民报网 - 越南政府总理范明正出席第三次越南国家数字技术企业发展论坛

chosen.text: Vietnam News Online - Vietnamese Prime Minister Pham Minh Chinh attended the Third Vietnam National Digital Technology Enterprise Development Forum

src: 第三次越南国家数字技术企业发展论坛期间举行两场主要会议，讨论议题围绕着数字技术企业与国家数字化转型、数字技术企业与新冠肺炎疫情中和疫情后经济复苏与发展两大主题。

chosen.text: Two major conferences were held during the third Vietnam National Digital Technology Enterprise Development Forum, with topics revolving around digital technology enterprises and national digital transformation, and digital technology enterprises and economic recovery and development during and after the COVID-19 pandemic.

src: 通信传媒部部长阮孟雄表示，2021年，尽管新冠肺炎疫情持续蔓延，但越南数字技术企业的数量和营业收入仍保持增长势头，达近10 % 。

chosen.text: Ruan Mengxiong, Minister of Information and Communications, said that in 2021, despite the continued spread of COVID-19, the number and operating income of Vietnamese digital technology enterprises still maintained growth momentum, reaching nearly 10%.

src: 2021年，越南典型数字产品数量耕作，集中解决越南面临的各大难题，许多数字产品已走出国门，越南数字技术排名已提升。

chosen.text: In 2021, a number of typical digital products were cultivated in Vietnam, which focused on solving major problems faced by Vietnam. Many digital products have gone abroad, and Vietnam's digital technology ranking has been improved.

src: 阮孟雄部长呼吁数字技术企业负起发展国家数字化转型平台的责任，担当发展这些国家数字平台的任务就是担当国家使命。

chosen.text: Minister Ruan Mengxiong called on digital technology enterprises to take responsibility for developing the national digital transformation platform, and the task of developing these national digital platforms is to undertake the national mission.

src: 在论坛上，各部门和国家机关领导，正在研究、发展、应用、转让数字技术的企业、组织和个人分享了动员和汇集全社会资源来发展越南技术企业，携手推动国家数字化转型，朱慧疫情后经济复苏等的各突破性设想和解决方案。

chosen.text: At the forum, leaders of various departments and state agencies, as well as enterprises, organizations and individuals who are studying, developing, applying and transferring digital technologies, shared their breakthrough ideas and solutions for mobilizing and gathering resources from the whole society to develop Vietnam’s technology enterprises, jointly promote the country’s digital transformation, and promote post-epidemic economic recovery.

src: 范明正总理在论坛上发表讲话时强调，数字化转型是世界必由之路，是发展的客观需求。

chosen.text: Prime Minister Fan Mingzheng emphasized in his speech at the forum that digital transformation is the only way for the world and is an objective requirement for development.

src: 数字化转型已成为全球性问题，数字化转型服务全民，因此需动员全民参与。

chosen.text: Digital transformation has become a global issue, and digital transformation services are for all, so it is necessary to mobilize the whole nation to participate.

src: 人民和企业是数字化转型的核心、主体、目标和动力。

chosen.text: People and enterprises are the core, main body, goal and driving force of digital transformation.

src: 因此，一切政策需为了人民和企业。

chosen.text: Therefore, all policies should be for the people and enterprises.

src: 范明正总理强调，数字化转型需体现民族精神，需以内力为主、战略、长期和决定性因素，外力为重要和突破口。

chosen.text: Prime Minister Pham Minh Chinh stressed that digital transformation should reflect national spirit, and should be based on internal forces, strategic, long-term and decisive factors, while external forces are important and breakthrough points.

src: 他同时认为，数字化转型需驱动向纵深发展和可持续发展，参与新冠肺炎疫情防控、经济复苏和发展、应对其后变化、克服自然资源枯竭现象，助力绿色转型、发展绿色能源。

chosen.text: He also believed that digital transformation should drive in-depth and sustainable development, participate in the prevention and control of COVID-19, economic recovery and development, respond to subsequent changes, overcome the phenomenon of natural resource depletion, help with green transformation, and develop green energy.

src: 数字化转型需参与保护和弘扬有关国家文化价值、历史传统、国家风土人情等的数据库建立工作，推动银行、税务、土地管理和开发数据库以及物流等领域数字化转型。

chosen.text: Digital transformation requires participation in the establishment of databases for protecting and promoting national cultural values, historical traditions, and national customs and habits, as well as the promotion of digital transformation in banks, tax, land management and development databases, logistics, and other fields.

src: 数字化转型的最大目标是让人民更幸福，国家日益繁荣发展。

chosen.text: The biggest goal of digital transformation is to make people happier and the country more prosperous.

src: 范明正总理要求各级政府、各级机关和企业在发展数字技术中需加大领导和指导力度，提高对数字化转型的认识，继续制定和完善关于数字化转型的体制，加强国家管理度和本着尊重、沟通、倾听、积极和主动的精神上推动对数字技术企业发展。

chosen.text: Prime Minister Fan Mingzheng required that all levels of government, all levels of institutions and enterprises should increase leadership and guidance in the development of digital technology, raise awareness of digital transformation, continue to formulate and improve the system of digital transformation, strengthen national management, and promote the development of digital technology enterprises in the spirit of respect, communication, listening, and positive and proactive.

src: 论坛期间，范明正总理出席了2021年“越南制造”优秀数字产品奖颁奖仪式及“越南制造”数字产品展开幕式。

chosen.text: During the forum, Prime Minister Pham Minh Chinh attended the award ceremony of the 2021 “Made in Vietnam” Excellent Digital Products Award and the opening ceremony of the Made in Vietnam Digital Product Exhibition.

chosen.text: Hunan Daily, December 10 (All-media reporter Zhou Zhouheng) On the 9th, the "Intelligent Xiangtan" 2021 China International Rail Transit and Equipment Manufacturing Industry Talent Summit opened in Zhuzhou.

src: 省委常委、省委组织部部长王成出席启动仪式并讲话。

chosen.text: Wang Cheng, member of the Standing Committee of the Provincial Party Committee and Minister of the Provincial Party Committee Organization Department, attended the launch ceremony and delivered a speech.

src: 王成指出，举办人才峰会是贯彻落实中央人才工作会议和省第十二次党代会精神的重要举措，彰显了湖南重视人才、渴求人才、用好人才的真心诚意。

chosen.text: Wang Cheng pointed out that holding the talent summit is an important measure to implement the spirit of the Central Talent Work Conference and the 12th Party Congress of the province, and it shows Hunan’s sincerity in valuing talents, seeking talents, and making good use of talents.

src: 湖南有识才爱才敬才的优良传统、助力人才发展的广阔平台、实现美好生活的环境条件，近年来深入实施人才引领发展战略，以芙蓉人才行动计划为牵引，构建起引育留用全链条人才工作格局，成为了人才成长成就的沃土、创新创业的热土、宜居宜业的乐土。

chosen.text: Hunan has a good tradition of recognizing, loving and respecting talents, a broad platform for talent development, and environmental conditions for realizing a better life. In recent years, it has deeply implemented the talent-led development strategy, built a talent work pattern of attracting, cultivating and retaining talents along the entire chain, and become a fertile soil for talent growth and achievement, a hot land for innovation and entrepreneurship, and a paradise for living and working.

src: 当前，湖南正在全面落实“三高四新”战略定位和使命任务，将进一步广开引贤纳才之门，为人才创新创业出台更优政策、集中更多资源、创造更好条件，期待各界优秀人才共同为湖南高质量发展聚智汇力。

chosen.text: At present, Hunan is comprehensively implementing the strategic positioning and mission of “three highs and four new”, and will further open the door to recruit talents and introduce more excellent talents, introduce more policies, concentrate more resources, and create better conditions for talent innovation and entrepreneurship. We look forward to the outstanding talents from all walks of life to work together to pool their wisdom and make efforts for the high-quality development of Hunan.

src: 活动现场设置了长沙、株洲、湘潭展馆和湖南自贸试验区展馆，省科技厅、省工信厅、省人社厅发布了先进制造相关产业科技创新重点需求清单、智能制造产业人才需求目录、博士后流动站智能制造产业青年人才需求目录。

src: 长江干流实现水上绿色综合服务区全覆盖-新华网

chosen.text: The Yangtze River mainstream has achieved full coverage of water-based green comprehensive service areas - Xinhuanet

src: 新华社武汉12月11日电（记者王贤）重庆市涪陵水上绿色综合服务区10日如期建成投入运营，这是继8日四川省泸州水上绿色综合服务区挂牌运营后，长江上游正式运营的第2个水上绿色综合服务区。

chosen.text: Xinhua News Agency, Wuhan, December 11 (Reporter Wang Xian) The Chongqing Fuling Water Green Comprehensive Service Area was completed and put into operation as scheduled on December 10. This is the second water green comprehensive service area officially put into operation in the upper reaches of the Yangtze River after the Sichuan Luzhou Water Green Comprehensive Service Area was put into operation on December 8.

src: 至此，水上绿色综合服务区已覆盖长江上、中、下游。

chosen.text: Up to now, the water-based green comprehensive service area has covered the upper, middle and lower reaches of the Yangtze River.

src: 交通运输部长江航务管理局副局长邱健华介绍说，此前，湖北、湖南、江西、安徽、江苏等省份已在长江中游、下游建成运行10个水上绿色综合服务区，得到了广大船员的认可，为推进长江航运高质量发展发挥了重要作用。

chosen.text: Qiu Jianhua, deputy director of the Yangtze River Shipping Administration Bureau of the Ministry of Transport, said that previously, Hubei, Hunan, Jiangxi, Anhui, Jiangsu and other provinces have built and operated 10 water-based green integrated service areas in the middle and lower reaches of the Yangtze River, which have been recognized by the majority of sailors and played an important role in promoting the high-quality development of Yangtze River shipping.

src: 水上绿色综合服务区全覆盖是长江绿色航运建设的又一里程碑事件，长江船舶污染物接收、航运服务能力得到显著提升。

chosen.text: The full coverage of green comprehensive service areas on water is another milestone event in the construction of green shipping on the Yangtze River, and the reception of ship pollutants and shipping services on the Yangtze River have been significantly improved.

src: 据介绍，水上绿色综合服务区是为广大船舶、船员提供全方位生产、生活服务，帮助广大船员解决“急难愁盼”问题的重要设施。

chosen.text: According to the introduction, the water green comprehensive service area is an important facility that provides all-round production and living services for ships and crew, and helps crew solve the problems of "urgency, difficulty, anxiety and expectation".

src: 此次建成运行的长江上游两处水上绿色综合服务区，集生活服务、生产服务和政务服务为一体，以绿色环保为主题，以船舶维修与船舶应急救援服务为特色，实现港内船舶“一次靠泊、多项服务 ” ， 将使得常年航行在长江的船员工作更高效、生活更便捷。

chosen.text: The two water-based green comprehensive service areas in the upper reaches of the Yangtze River, which have been completed and put into operation this time, integrate living services, production services and government services, take green environmental protection as the theme, take ship maintenance and ship emergency rescue services as the characteristics, realize "one-time berthing, multiple services" for ships in the port, and will make the work of crew members who sail on the Yangtze River more efficient and their life more convenient.

src: 据中国智库“南海战略态势感知平台”消息，1月9日，卫星在巴拉巴克海峡附近发现了美军“卡尔·文森”号（USS Carl Vinson）航母。

src: 该平台预计，“卡尔·文森”号将前往南海部署。
