chosen.text: This is the first time that the "Carl Vinson" aircraft carrier has deployed with F-35C fighter jets and CMV-22 Osprey amphibious transport aircraft.

src: 现在正在太平洋上游弋的美军航母，除了“卡尔·文森”号外，还有1月3日从美国出发的“亚伯拉罕·林肯”号（USS Abraham Lincoln）航母。

chosen.text: In addition to the Carl Vinson, the US aircraft carrier that is currently cruising in the Pacific Ocean is the USS Abraham Lincoln, which departed from the United States on January 3.

src: 除了上述两艘航母外，目前美国海军部署在亚太地区的还有停靠在日本横须贺的“里根”号（USS Ronald Reagan）航母。

chosen.text: In addition to the above two aircraft carriers, the US Navy currently has the USS Ronald Reagan aircraft carrier, which is docked in Yokosuka, Japan, deployed in the Asia-Pacific region.

src: 美三航母集结中国周边 最强大武器罕见访问关岛 分析称，这是向印度-太平洋地区日益紧张的局势中的盟友和敌人发出了一个信号。

chosen.text: The three US aircraft carriers gathered around China, and the most powerful weapon made a rare visit to Guam. According to analysts, this is a signal sent to allies and enemies in the increasingly tense situation in the Indian-Pacific region.

src: 这是美国弹道导弹潜艇自2016年以来首次访问关岛，也是自20世纪80年代以来第二次公开访问关岛。

chosen.text: This is the first visit of the US ballistic missile submarine to Guam since 2016, and the second public visit to Guam since the 1980s.

src: 美三航母集结中国周边 最强大武器罕见访问关岛 中国近年来在南沙群岛修建大批军事设施。

chosen.text: Three US aircraft carriers gather around China. The most powerful weapons rarely visit Guam. China has built a large number of military facilities in the Nansha Islands in recent years.

src: 图为中国在南沙群岛的永暑岛。

chosen.text: The picture shows Yongshu Island in the Nansha Islands.

src: （南海研究论坛） 美国海军在声明中称，俄亥俄级核潜艇“内华达号”此次对关岛的访问加强了美国和该地区盟友之间的合作，展示了美国的能力、灵活性、战备状态，以及对印太地区安全与稳定的持续承诺。

chosen.text: (South China Sea Research Forum) The US Navy said in a statement that the visit of the Ohio-class nuclear submarine "Nevada" to Guam strengthened the cooperation between the United States and its allies in the region, showed the ability, flexibility, and combat readiness of the United States, and its continued commitment to the security and stability of the Indo-Pacific region.

src: 弹道导弹潜艇通常被称为“雷鸣潜艇”（Boomer submarine）。

chosen.text: Ballistic missile submarines are commonly referred to as "Boomer" submarines.

src: 美国海军舰队中14艘“雷鸣潜艇”的行踪通常是被严格保密的。

chosen.text: The whereabouts of 14 "thundering submarines" in the U.S. Navy fleet is usually kept strictly confidential.

src: 围绕着弹道导弹潜艇的秘密使“雷鸣潜艇”成为“核三位一体中最重要的生存武器”，这一体系还包括位于美国本土的发射井弹道导弹，以及B-2和B-52等可携带核弹头的轰炸机。

chosen.text: The secret surrounding the ballistic missile submarine makes the "booming submarine" the "most important survival weapon in the nuclear triad", and this system also includes the ballistic missile launch shafts in the United States, as well as the B-2 and B-52 bombers that can carry nuclear warheads.

src: 跟朋友聊起最近Meta大跌 26%，市值蒸发 2510 亿美元，扎克伯格回应「面临前所未有的竞争」，原因为何？

chosen.text: When I told a friend about Meta's recent 26% drop, a $251 billion evaporation, Zuckerberg responded that he was "facing unprecedented competition." Why?

src: Meta（原 Facebook）实质是一家广告公司，收入主要来自于广告，今时今日赚钱的广告公司，自己是有流量渠道的。

chosen.text: Meta (formerly Facebook) is essentially an advertising company, and its income mainly comes from advertising. Today's advertising companies that make money have their own traffic channels.

src: Facebook，Instagram，Whatsapp 等等，无论什么样的功能定位，都是 Meta 的流量渠道。

chosen.text: Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp and so on, regardless of what functions they have, are Meta's traffic channels.

src: 不仅如此，Meta 还是最大的”广告联盟”,很多 App 外接 Meta 的广告，通过 Meta 的广告平台是实现变现。

chosen.text: In addition, Meta is also the largest "advertising alliance". Many apps connect to Meta's ads, and monetization can be achieved through Meta's advertising platform.

src: 但是，时代变了。

chosen.text: But times have changed.

src: 第一，因为苹果隐私政策的调整，Meta 很难再拿到用户的数据信息，影响了广告投放的效率。

chosen.text: First, because of the adjustment of Apple's privacy policy, Meta has difficulty in getting user data information, which affects the efficiency of advertising placement.

src: 苹果现在的隐私政策对用户很友好，会很明显的提示用户是否允许 App 获取自己的信息，大多数人的正常反应肯定是不允许。

chosen.text: Apple's current privacy policy is user-friendly, and it will clearly prompt users whether they allow the app to get their information, and most people's normal reaction is definitely not to allow.

src: 接下来如果 Google 再捅一刀，对 Meta 的收入影响还会更大。

chosen.text: If Google pulls another stunt, the impact on Meta's revenue could be even greater.

src: 第二，以前 Meta 的收入增长里的中国因素也弱化了（这个因素的比重不确定有多高，但确实存在）。

chosen.text: Second, the China factor in Meta’s previous revenue growth has also weakened (the proportion of this factor is uncertain, but it does exist).

src: 大家平时都知道 Meta 在中国是没有业务的，但是这个理解并不准确。

chosen.text: Everyone knows that Meta has no business in China, but this understanding is not accurate.

src: 每年 Meta 至少10%的收入都来自中国，主要是中国做出海业务的公司贡献的。

chosen.text: At least 10% of Meta's revenue comes from China each year, mainly from companies that do business in China.

src: Meta 在香港的办公室大概几百人，在大陆还有几大代理商。

chosen.text: Meta has about hundreds of employees in its Hong Kong office, and several major agents in the mainland.

src: 中国公司想要拓展海外市场，Meta 都是绕不过的广告渠道，烧的钱大多都给了 Meta。

chosen.text: Meta is an advertising channel that Chinese companies cannot bypass when they want to expand overseas markets, and most of the money they spend goes to Meta.

src: 有意思的是，现在字节的 TT 是 Meta 主要的竞争对手之一，但是前两年 Meta 从字节身上可赚到不少钱。

chosen.text: Interestingly, Byte's TT is now one of Meta's main competitors, but Meta made a lot of money from Byte in the past two years.

src: 国内各个代理都在帮字节去 Meta 那里投广告，Meta 大中华区的业绩也很不错。

chosen.text: All domestic agents are helping ByteDance to place advertisements on Meta, and Meta’s performance in Greater China is also very good.

src: 最近我没有专门去了解，但是肯定不会比之前好。

chosen.text: I haven't looked at it recently, but I'm sure it's not any better than before.

src: 中国公司在海外大规模烧钱的阶段已经过去了。

chosen.text: The stage of Chinese companies burning money overseas on a large scale has passed.

src: 第三，新的流量渠道拓展不顺利。

chosen.text: Third, the expansion of new traffic channels is not smooth.

src: Facebook 越来越老了，新的包括 TT 在内的平台，都不在 Meta 手中。

chosen.text: Facebook is getting older and new platforms, including TT, are not in Meta's hands.

src: 最大的问题不仅仅是收入下滑，而是缺乏增长预期。

chosen.text: The biggest problem is not just the decline in income, but the lack of growth expectations.

src: 资本市场不仅仅看中收入，更重要的是看未来的预期怎么样。

chosen.text: The capital market is not only interested in income, but more importantly, it is interested in future expectations.

src: 很显然，Meta 的预期是不够的。

chosen.text: It's clear Meta's expectations weren't enough.

src: 为了给市场讲出新的故事，扎克伯格讲了 “元宇宙”.

chosen.text: In order to tell a new story to the market, Zuckerberg talked about the "metaverse".

src: 元宇宙确实应该是未来的方向之一，但是元宇宙的实现周期比较长，这个故事在这两三年应该不足以支撑起 Meta 的市值。

chosen.text: The metaverse is indeed one of the future directions, but the implementation cycle of the metaverse is relatively long, and this story should not be enough to support Meta’s market value in the next two or three years.

src: 所以未来这两年，应该是 Meta 比较艰难的时期。

chosen.text: So the next two years should be a difficult period for Meta.

src: 别看脸书现在非常的风光，每年也有1,000亿到2,000亿美元的收入，实际上脸书现在危机感非常强，跟其他的互联网企业和高科技公司相比，没有什么好的安全的护城河。

chosen.text: Although Facebook is very prosperous now and has an annual income of $100 billion to $200 billion, in fact, Facebook is now very crisis-stricken. Compared with other Internet companies and high-tech companies, it has no good and safe moat.

src: 虽然他的几款社交软件现在的日活比较高，也是主流的社交软件，比如Facebook，WhatsApp等等，但是面对tiktok的快速发展，脸书也没有什么信心，颠覆之间也就是眨眼的功夫。

chosen.text: Although his several social software now have high daily activity and are mainstream social software, such as Facebook, WhatsApp, etc., Facebook has no confidence in the face of the rapid development of TikTok. The subversion is just a blink of an eye.

src: 而搞元宇宙这个可望而不可及的概念，短时间之内完全没有成功的希望，因此脸书非常的危险，这也是为什么扎克伯格又是换公司的名字，又是不停的寻找新的赛道的根本原因，但是我觉得他的赛道选择是错的，是一条不归路 以上是我的一些思考，供参考。

chosen.text: The concept of metaverse is out of reach, and there is no hope of success in a short time. Therefore, Facebook is very dangerous. This is also the fundamental reason why Zuckerberg changed the company name and kept looking for new tracks. However, I think his track selection is wrong, and it is a dead end. The above are my thoughts for reference.

src: 第十七条 国家对注册消防工程师资格实行注册执业管理制度。

chosen.text: Article 17 The state shall implement a registration and practice management system for registered fire engineers.

src: 取得一级、二级注册消防工程师资格证书的人员，经注册方可以相应级别注册消防工程师名义执业。

chosen.text: Those who have obtained the qualification certificate of the first and second level registered fire engineer can practice in the name of the corresponding level registered fire engineer after registration.

src: 第十八条 公安部消防局是一级注册消防工程师资格的注册审批部门。

chosen.text: Article 18 The Fire Protection Bureau of the Ministry of Public Security is the registration and approval department for first-level registered fire engineers.

src: 省、自治区、直辖市公安机关消防机构为二级注册消防工程师资格的注册审批部门，并负责一级注册消防工程师资格注册的初步审查工作。

chosen.text: The firefighting institutions of the public security organs of provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities directly under the Central Government are the registration and approval departments for the qualification of the second-level registered fire protection engineer, and are responsible for the preliminary review of the registration of the qualification of the first-level registered fire protection engineer.

src: 第十九条 取得一级、二级注册消防工程师资格证书并申请注册的人员，应当受聘于一个经批准的消防技术服务机构或者消防安全重点单位，并通过聘用单位向本单位所在地(聘用单位属企业的，通过本企业向工商注册所在地)的公安机关消防机构提交注册申请材料。

chosen.text: Article 19 Persons who have obtained the qualification certificates of first-class and second-class registered fire engineers and apply for registration shall be employed by an approved fire technical service institution or a key fire safety unit, and submit the registration application materials to the fire protection agency of the public security organ at the location of the unit (if the employing unit is an enterprise, submit it to the industrial and commercial registration location through the enterprise).

src: 第二十条 省、自治区、直辖市公安机关消防机构在收到申请人的注册申请材料后，对申请材料不齐全或者不符合法定形式的，应当当场或者在5个工作日内，一次 性告知申请人需要补正的全部内容，逾期不告知的，自收到申请材料之日起即为受理。

chosen.text: Article 20 After receiving the registration application materials of the applicant, the fire protection institution of the public security organs of the provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities directly under the central government shall inform the applicant of all the contents that need to be corrected at one time on the spot or within 5 working days if the application materials are incomplete or do not meet the statutory form. If the applicant is not informed within the time limit, it shall be accepted from the date of receipt of the application materials.

src: 对受理或者不予受理的注册申请，均应当出具加盖本级公安机关消防机构专用印章和注明日期的书面凭证。

chosen.text: For the registration application that is accepted or not accepted, a written certificate stamped with the special seal of the fire department of the public security organ at the same level and the date shall be issued.

src: 第二十一条 省、自治区、直辖市公安机关消防机构自受理注册申请之日起20个工作日内，按规定条件和程序完成一级注册消防工程师资格注册申请材料的初步审查工作和二级注册消防工程师资格的注册审批工作，并将一级注册消防工程师资格注册申请材料和初步审查意见报公安部消防局审批。

chosen.text: Article 21 The fire protection institutions of the public security organs of provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities directly under the central government shall complete the preliminary review of the registration application materials of the first-level registered fire engineer and the registration and approval of the second-level registered fire engineer within 20 working days from the date of acceptance of the registration application, and shall report the registration application materials of the first-level registered fire engineer and the preliminary review opinion to the Fire Department of the Ministry of Public Security for approval.

src: 公安部消防局应当自收到省级公安机关消防机构报送的申请材料和初步审查意见之日起，20个工作日内作出是否批准的决定。

chosen.text: The Fire Bureau of the Ministry of Public Security shall make a decision on whether to approve within 20 working days from the date of receiving the application materials and preliminary review opinions submitted by the fire institutions of provincial public security organs.

src: 在规定的期限内不能作出批准决定的，应当将延长的期限和理由告知申请人。

chosen.text: If the approval decision cannot be made within the prescribed time limit, the applicant shall be informed of the extended period and reasons.

src: 对作出不予批准决定的，应当书面说明理由，并告知申请人享有依法申请行政复议或者提起行政诉讼的权利。

chosen.text: If a decision is made not to approve, the reasons shall be stated in writing and the applicant shall be informed of his/her right to apply for administrative reconsideration or initiate an administrative lawsuit according to law.

src: 第二十二条 注册审批部门应当自作出批准决定之日起10个工作日内，颁发、送达相应级别的注册证。

chosen.text: Article 22 The registration and approval department shall issue and deliver the corresponding level of registration certificate within 10 working days from the date of making the approval decision.

src: 第二十三条 注册证的每一注册有效期为3年。

chosen.text: Article 23 Each registration certificate shall be valid for three years.

src: 注册证在有效期内是相应级别注册消防工程师的执业凭证，由注册消防工程师本人保管、使用。

chosen.text: The registration certificate is the practice certificate of the registered fire engineer at the corresponding level during the validity period, and shall be kept and used by the registered fire engineer himself/herself.

src: 第二十四条 申请初始注册的，应当自取得一级、二级注册消防工程师资格证书之日起1年内提出申请。

chosen.text: Article 24: For initial registration, an application shall be filed within one year from the date of obtaining the qualification certificate for first-level and second-level registered fire engineers.

src: 逾期申请初始注册时，须符合本规定继续教育要求。

chosen.text: When applying for initial registration after the expiry of the deadline, the applicant must meet the continuing education requirements of this regulation.

src: 初始注册、延续注册、变更注册、注销注册和不予注册等注册管理的具体办法，由公安部另行规定。

chosen.text: Specific measures for registration management, such as initial registration, renewal registration, change registration, cancellation registration and non-registration shall be separately stipulated by the Ministry of Public Security.

src: 第二十五条 继续教育是注册消防工程师延续注册、重新注册和逾期初始注册的必备条件。

chosen.text: Article 25 Continuing education is a necessary condition for the renewal of registration, re-registration and overdue initial registration of registered fire engineers.

src: 在每个注册有效期内，各级别注册消防工程师应当按照规定完成相应的继续教育。

chosen.text: During each registration period, registered fire protection engineers at all levels should complete the corresponding continuing education as required.

src: 第二十六条 注册审批部门应当及时向社会公告注册消防工程师注册有关情况，建立注册消防工程师诚信档案，对其执业活动实行信用管理。

chosen.text: Article 26 The registration and approval department shall promptly announce to the public the relevant information of the registered fire engineers, establish a credit file for registered fire engineers, and implement credit management for their practice activities.

src: 第二十七条 各级注册消防工程师资格的注册管理部门，应当严格执行《中华人民共和国行政许可法》有关规定。

chosen.text: Article 27 The registration management department of the qualification of registered fire engineer at all levels shall strictly implement the relevant provisions of the Administrative License Law of the People's Republic of China.

src: 中越两军“和平救援-2021”卫勤联合演习圆满结束-新华网

chosen.text: The "Peace Rescue - 2021" Joint Medical Exercise of the Chinese and Vietnamese Armies was successfully concluded - Xinhuanet

src: 新华社河内12月12日电（周娜 滕怀金）12日上午，参加中越两军“和平救援-2021”卫勤联合演习的中方参演分队全部安全返回中国广西境内，标志着此次持续7天的演训任务顺利完成。

chosen.text: Xinhua News Agency, Ha Noi, December 12 (Zhou Na, Teng Huaijin) - On the morning of December 12, all the Chinese participating units in the "Peace Rescue-2021" joint medical exercise between China and Vietnam returned safely to Guangxi, China, marking the successful completion of the seven-day exercise mission.

src: 此次联演，中越两军围绕人道主义医学救援这一重大课题，紧扣卫勤救死扶伤使命任务，按照实战化标准完成了联合卫勤指挥、联合现场救援、批量伤员处置等课目内容，有效提升了两军卫勤保障能力。

chosen.text: In this joint exercise, the two armies of China and Vietnam focused on the major topic of humanitarian medical rescue, closely adhered to the mission of logistics and rescue, and completed the contents of joint logistics command, joint on-site rescue, and mass casualty treatment according to the standard of real combat, effectively improving the logistics support capabilities of the two armies.

src: 演习成果得到中越两军的肯定。

chosen.text: The results of the exercise were affirmed by both the Chinese and Vietnamese armies.

src: 越方演习指导委员会主任、越南人民军后勤总局副主任兼参谋长阮雄胜在演习结束仪式上说，通过此次演习，越南军医从中国军医身上学到了演习组织及专业活动方面的知识，也见识了中方的医疗、保障设备。

chosen.text: Ruan Xiongsheng, Director of the Steering Committee for the Vietnamese military exercise, Deputy Director and Chief of Staff of the General Logistics Department of the Vietnamese People's Army, said at the ceremony that ended the exercise that through this exercise, the Vietnamese military doctors learned knowledge about the organization of the exercise and professional activities from the Chinese military doctors, and also saw the medical and support equipment of China.

src: 演习取得的成果证明了两国军医力量在医疗援助、疫情防控方面的专业能力。

chosen.text: The results of the exercise proved the professional capabilities of the military medical forces of the two countries in medical assistance and epidemic prevention and control.

src: 中方指导协调组组长、中央军委后勤保障部卫生局副局长陈春明表示，此次演习是在2018年成功举办联合义诊活动的基础上又一次开拓创新实践，具有非常重要的里程碑意义。

chosen.text: Chen Chunming, head of the Chinese Steering and Coordination Group and deputy director of the Health Bureau of the Logistics Support Department of the Central Military Commission, said that this exercise is another pioneering and innovative practice based on the successful joint free clinic in 2018, which has very important milestone significance.

src: 演习期间，中国人民解放军向越南人民军捐赠了医用防护口罩、医用防护服、快速核酸检测仪器等卫生防疫物资。

chosen.text: During the exercise, the People's Liberation Army donated medical protective masks, medical protective clothing, rapid nucleic acid testing instruments and other health and epidemic prevention supplies to the Vietnam People's Army.
